66419.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中，多顆深藍色細胞質的前紅血球母細胞與一顆帶顆粒的前骨髓細胞，細胞質內都有明顯的圓形空泡 (cytoplasmic vacuoles)，紅系與骨髓系同時空泡化，提示銅缺乏 (copper deficiency)。
features: Proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing discrete, clear round vacuoles
A granulated promyelocyte with numerous coarse cytoplasmic vacuoles (center left)
Erythroid precursors predominate with left shift; late erythroblasts with condensed nuclei, some binucleate or with irregular nuclear budding
A mature neutrophil and scattered myelocytes present, but mature granulocytes are relatively few
Background red cells without notable abnormality
66419.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows left-shifted erythropoiesis with numerous proerythroblasts that contain distinct cytoplasmic vacuoles, accompanied by late erythroblasts showing dyserythropoietic features such as binucleation and irregular nuclear contours. Granulocytic precursors, including a promyelocyte, also show prominent cytoplasmic vacuolation, and mature neutrophils are relatively reduced. No increase in blasts or Auer rods is seen in this field. In the clinical setting of excess zinc intake and enteral feeding, the findings are consistent with acquired copper deficiency; serum copper, ceruloplasmin and zinc levels should be measured.

ddx.vs: MDS lacks reversible vacuolation of early precursors and shows clonal genetic changes, whereas copper deficiency has low serum copper and resolves with replacement.
Ethanol produces identical proerythroblast vacuoles, so distinction rests on drinking history and normal copper levels.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of atypical proerythroblasts (≥80% erythroid, ≥30% proerythroblasts) without granulocytic vacuolation.
Pearson syndrome is a pediatric mitochondrial DNA deletion disorder and drug effect requires exposure history, while morphology overlaps.

66291.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中兩顆中性球的細胞核分成約 6 葉以上、以細絲相連，細胞質顆粒正常；只要看到一顆 ≥6 葉或多顆 5 葉的中性球即屬核分葉過多（hypersegmentation），首先要想到維生素 B12/葉酸缺乏。
features: Two neutrophils with hypersegmented nuclei, each with approximately 6 or more discrete lobes connected by thin chromatin strands
Condensed, clumped mature chromatin within each lobe
Cell size normal to slightly enlarged; cytoplasm pale pink with fine neutrophilic granules, no toxic granulation or vacuoles
Background red cells mostly normocytic with mild anisocytosis; a few platelets present
66291.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with hypersegmented nuclei, each displaying approximately six or more lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments, with condensed chromatin and normally granulated cytoplasm. No toxic changes or inclusions are present. Background red cells show mild anisocytosis without obvious macro-ovalocytes in this field, and platelets are present. Findings represent neutrophil hypersegmentation, which is suggestive of megaloblastic hematopoiesis (vitamin B12 or folate deficiency) and warrants correlation with MCV and vitamin levels.

ddx.vs: Myelokathectic neutrophils have fewer, rounded, pyknotic lobes separated by very long filaments with chronic neutropenia, rather than many normally shaped lobes.

ddx.dx: Hereditary neutrophil hypersegmentation / drug effect (e.g., hydroxyurea, methotrexate)
ddx.vs: These show similar hypersegmentation; distinction relies on medication history, family studies and normal B12/folate rather than morphology.
Two superimposed band or segmented neutrophils show two cytoplasmic outlines, whereas here each hypersegmented nucleus sits within a single intact cell membrane.
Occasional 5-lobed neutrophils occur in these states, but they lack accompanying macro-ovalocytes and the degree of lobation is usually less marked.

66227.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（H&E）中可見多處組織球內外成群、大小一致的小圓形透明體（約 2–4 µm），每顆周圍有淡色空暈（clear halo），呈泡泡狀聚集，是莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma）酵母型；背景仍有造血細胞、巨核細胞與脂肪細胞。
features: Multifocal clusters of numerous small, uniform round to oval bodies (approximately 2-4 micrometers) with pale centers and surrounding clear halos
Organisms are packed within expanded histiocytes and also appear extracellular in the interstitium, giving a bubbly appearance
Occasional larger round clear spaces within the aggregates
Intervening hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes, and scattered fat spaces
No well-formed granulomas or necrosis in this field; internal detail of organisms not resolved at this magnification
66227.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows cellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes, and interspersed fat. Multifocal aggregates of histiocytes are distended by numerous small, uniform, round to oval intracellular and extracellular yeast-like bodies with surrounding clear halos. Well-formed granulomas and necrosis are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis; the organisms should be confirmed with GMS and PAS stains, and culture, urine or serum antigen testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes lack a clear halo, do not stain with GMS or PAS, and show a rod-shaped kinetoplast next to the nucleus on Giemsa.
T. marneffei yeasts are similar in size but more elongated with a central transverse septum from fission rather than budding.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size (4-10 micrometers or more) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.

ddx.dx: Storage or foamy histiocytes (e.g., Gaucher, lipid-laden macrophages)
ddx.vs: Storage cells have wrinkled or finely vacuolated cytoplasm without discrete GMS-positive round organisms.

66163.recognize_zh: 低倍（4x）PAS 染色的骨髓切片，骨小梁之間大部分被均勻淡粉紅色的片狀細胞占據，只剩少數藍色的造血細胞島嶼；此淡粉紅區即 PAS 陽性的 Gaucher 細胞浸潤，低倍下難與 H&E 區分。
features: Low-power trephine core with a branching trabecular network
Extensive confluent sheets of pale pink PAS-positive cells replacing much of the intertrabecular marrow
Residual blue hematopoietic islands scattered between the pink sheets
Near absence of marrow fat
Cytologic detail and diastase resistance cannot be assessed at 4x
66163.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy stained with PAS shows extensive replacement of the intertrabecular marrow by confluent sheets of pale pink PAS-positive cells, with only residual islands of hematopoietic cells and little fat. Cytologic features are not assessable at this magnification, and diastase-resistance requires a paired PAS-D section. In correlation with higher-power morphology, findings are consistent with extensive Gaucher cell infiltration of the marrow.

ddx.vs: Fibrosis and edema show spindle cells or loose stroma that are PAS weak and reticulin positive, without sheets of large histiocytes.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells are PAS positive too, and require the background disease and glucocerebrosidase activity for separation.
Mucinous carcinoma forms cohesive glands or signet ring cells with PAS-positive mucin and is cytokeratin positive rather than CD68 positive.

66035.recognize_zh: 光學抹片血小板大致正常、偶見顏色淡而偏大的低顆粒血小板（A 圖小框）；全載電顯（B）缺乏對照組（C）中清楚的黑色緻密顆粒，薄切片（D、E）見 α 顆粒減少並偶有巨大 α 顆粒，符合 FLI1 相關血小板減少症。
features: Panel A: blood smear with mildly reduced platelets of mostly normal size; inset shows an enlarged, pale, hypogranular platelet
Panel B: whole-mount EM of patient platelet lacking discrete electron-dense (dense) granules, showing only gray mottling
Panel C: healthy control whole-mount platelet with multiple sharply defined black dense granules
Panel D: thin-section EM with platelets showing reduced alpha granules; arrows mark enlarged granules
Panel E: platelet containing a single giant alpha granule; Panel F: control platelets with normal numerous alpha granules
66035.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with platelets that are mostly normal in size, with rare enlarged hypogranular forms (inset). Whole-mount electron microscopy of the patient's platelets shows absence of dense granules compared with a healthy control, which displays multiple discrete electron-dense bodies. Thin-section electron microscopy shows reduced alpha granules with occasional giant alpha granules, in contrast to the numerous normal-sized alpha granules in control platelets. Combined with mild macrothrombocytopenia and a heterozygous FLI1 deletion, findings are consistent with FLI1-related thrombocytopenia (Paris-Trousseau-type platelet defect).

ddx.vs: Gray platelet syndrome shows large, gray agranular platelets with near-absent alpha granules but preserved dense granules and myelofibrosis, not dense granule absence with giant alpha granules.
HPS also lacks dense granules on whole-mount EM, but platelet count and alpha granules are normal and oculocutaneous albinism is present.
MYH9-RD shows uniformly giant platelets with Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions and normal granule ultrastructure.
ITP has normal platelet granule content on EM, no lifelong course and no germline FLI1 variant.

65971.recognize_zh: 紅血球間散在多種碎裂紅血球（schistocytes），包括頭盔狀（helmet cell）、三角形與不規則收縮的碎片，視野內幾乎看不到血小板，符合微血管病變性溶血合併嚴重血小板低下。
features: Multiple fragmented red cells: helmet cells, triangular fragments and irregular contracted forms
Fragments lack central pallor and show sharp angular edges or straight cut margins
Remaining red cells are normocytic with central pallor, some with mild crenation
Platelets markedly decreased; essentially none visible in this field
One neutrophil with a band/C-shaped nucleus and fine granules; no nucleated red cells or spherocyte clusters
65971.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells, triangular fragments, and irregularly contracted forms with sharp angular margins. Platelets are markedly decreased, with essentially none identified in this field. A single neutrophil with a band-form nucleus is present without toxic changes or blasts. Findings are consistent with microangiopathic hemolysis with severe thrombocytopenia; correlation with LDH, haptoglobin, coagulation studies (DIC screen), and ADAMTS13 activity is recommended.

ddx.dx: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura / hemolytic uremic syndrome
ddx.vs: TTP/HUS produce identical schistocytes; TTP is distinguished by ADAMTS13 activity <10% and HUS by renal failure with Shiga toxin or complement abnormalities, with normal coagulation times.
DIC shows schistocytes with prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen and elevated D-dimer, which is expected in dengue-associated coagulopathy.
Bite cells have a semicircular bite with an intact cell and Heinz bodies on supravital stain, not triangular or helmet-shaped fragments.
Artifactual echinocytes have regular scalloped spicules evenly around an intact cell and appear in thick areas, unlike true fragmented cells.

65779.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大型母細胞胞質豐富灰藍，內含淡粉紅、團塊狀的非典型胞質包涵體（紅箭頭），部分母細胞吞噬紅血球（黑箭頭）；核型與 FISH 顯示 KMT2A 斷裂重排。
features: Large blasts with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and round to folded nuclei with fine chromatin
Pale pink, finely granular globular cytoplasmic inclusions, often perinuclear and indenting the nucleus (red arrows)
Erythrophagocytosis by blasts: engulfed red cells within cytoplasmic vacuoles (black arrows)
Occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods evident
Karyotype showing complex abnormalities involving chromosomes 3, 6, 9 and 20
Interphase FISH with KMT2A break-apart probe showing separated 5' and 3' signals
65779.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate is replaced by large blasts with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, fine nuclear chromatin and folded to round nuclei. Many blasts contain pale pink, granular globular cytoplasmic inclusions, and a subset show erythrophagocytosis with engulfed red cells in cytoplasmic vacuoles. The accompanying karyotype is complex, and KMT2A break-apart FISH shows split signals indicating KMT2A rearrangement. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic features and KMT2A::MLLT3 rearrangement, displaying unusual cytoplasmic inclusions and erythrophagocytosis.

ddx.vs: Both show monocytic blasts with erythrophagocytosis; the distinction rests on cytogenetics/FISH (KMT2A split here versus KAT6A::CREBBP fusion).
Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules are large, discrete, MPO-positive azurophilic granules, whereas these inclusions are pale pink finely granular aggregates in MPO-negative blasts.
HLH erythrophagocytosis is by mature benign histiocytes with low N:C ratio, not by immature blasts with fine chromatin.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei, heavy azurophilic granules or Auer rod bundles and are MPO-strong and HLA-DR-negative, unlike these HLA-DR+ MPO-negative blasts.

65651.recognize_zh: 中央這顆嗜中性球的核清楚分成 6 葉，圓形小葉緊密排列、染色質濃縮，細胞質淡粉紅含細顆粒；單顆嗜中性球出現 ≥6 葉即可判定為分葉過多。
features: Single neutrophil with six distinct rounded nuclear lobes
Dense, clumped mature chromatin in each lobe
Moderate pale pink cytoplasm with fine granules
No obvious toxic granulation, Döhle bodies, or vacuoles
Background red cells mostly normocytic with occasional poikilocytes; platelets present
65651.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single neutrophil with six distinct nuclear lobes and condensed chromatin within a normal-sized cell. The cytoplasm has fine granules without obvious toxic changes. Background red cells are largely normocytic with occasional poikilocytes, and platelets are seen. A neutrophil with six or more lobes meets the definition of hypersegmentation; findings are consistent with neutrophil hypersegmentation, and vitamin B12/folate status and drug history should be reviewed.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia is supported by accompanying macro-ovalocytes, raised MCV, and low B12 or folate, which morphology of a single neutrophil cannot confirm.
The inherited trait affects most neutrophils in an otherwise healthy person with normal vitamin levels and a family history.
It is morphologically indistinguishable and is identified by medication history.
Giant neutrophils are clearly larger than neighbors with many lobes, whereas this cell is of normal size.

64947.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央有一團無結構、淡藍紫色的細胞外沉積物，邊界不規則，內部夾著幾個被拉長的紅血球；這種非細胞性的淡藍色物質（箭頭）即冷凝球蛋白沉澱，旁邊白血球與紅血球形態大致正常。
features: Amorphous, pale blue-lavender extracellular deposit with irregular borders (arrow)
Deposit is acellular and homogeneous, trapping a few distorted red cells
No internal structure, nuclei, or granules within the deposit
Surrounding red cells largely normocytic; several neutrophils in the field appear normal
No rouleaux or red cell agglutination evident in this field
64947.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an amorphous, homogeneous pale blue extracellular deposit with irregular borders that entraps a few distorted red cells, without nuclei or internal structure. Background red cells and neutrophils appear unremarkable, and no rouleaux or agglutination is seen in this field. Such deposits represent precipitated cryoglobulin forming as the sample cools. Findings are suggestive of cryoglobulinemia, which in a patient with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma is typically a type I or II monoclonal IgM cryoglobulin; repeat smear from a sample kept at 37 C and cryoglobulin testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Stain precipitate is dark, granular, and overlies cells across the slide, whereas cryoglobulin is pale, homogeneous, and disappears when the sample is warmed.
Cold agglutinins produce clumps of intact red cells rather than an acellular protein deposit.
Rouleaux are stacked red cells with a blue-tinged background, without discrete amorphous extracellular globules.
Fibrin is fibrillary and platelet clumps contain granular platelets, unlike the homogeneous pale blue deposit here.

65459.recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴球的淡藍色細胞質中有數個深紫色的小點狀包涵體，每一顆周圍都有清楚的透明暈（halo），這是淋巴球中的 Alder-Reilly 包涵體，常見於黏多醣症。
features: Single lymphocyte with a round nucleus and a narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Multiple discrete dark purple dot-like cytoplasmic inclusions
Each inclusion surrounded by a clear vacuole-like halo
Inclusions distributed around the nuclear periphery, one overlying the nucleus
Background red cells unremarkable with scattered platelets
65459.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with a round nucleus and a rim of pale blue cytoplasm containing multiple discrete dark purple granular inclusions. Each inclusion is surrounded by a clear halo, and the inclusions are arranged around the nucleus. The background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with Alder-Reilly inclusions in a lymphocyte, suggestive of a mucopolysaccharidosis or related storage disorder.

ddx.dx: Azurophilic granules of large granular lymphocytes
ddx.vs: LGL granules are fine, red-purple, clustered, and lack surrounding clear halos.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated lymphocytes of other storage diseases (e.g., Batten disease, Pompe disease)
ddx.vs: These show clear empty vacuoles without a central dark granule, whereas these vacuoles contain dense metachromatic dots.
Organisms have internal structure and are usually found in neutrophils or monocytes, not uniform dots with halos in lymphocytes.
Chédiak-Higashi granules are few, giant, and irregular azurophilic granules, not multiple small dots each surrounded by a halo.

65395.recognize_zh: 拼圖中多數大型漿細胞核偏位、細胞質豐富淡藍並有核周淡染區，另有細胞質邊緣呈絲狀或破碎的漿細胞與雙核形態，背景紅血球錢串狀排列，支持漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Numerous large plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and abundant pale to deep blue cytoplasm
Perinuclear hof visible in many cells; some with frayed or wispy cytoplasmic margins
Occasional binucleated plasma cells and cells with granular cytoplasm
Chromatin moderately coarse; nucleoli not prominent in most cells
Rouleaux formation in the background; scattered neutrophils and a nucleated red cell
65395.describe_en: Composite bone marrow aspirate fields show many plasma cells, several of which are enlarged with abundant cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei and a perinuclear hof. Some cells display frayed cytoplasmic borders and occasional binucleation, and a few have finely granular cytoplasm. Background red cells show rouleaux, and scattered neutrophils and erythroid cells are present. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature and polytypic without enlarged or multinucleated forms.
Features a mixture of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with MYD88 L265P rather than a predominance of large atypical plasma cells.
Histiocytes have folded or oval nuclei with fine chromatin, gray vacuolated cytoplasm and no perinuclear hof.

65203.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中嗜酸性球明顯增多，且許多嗜酸性球顆粒分布不均、細胞質有空泡、核分葉異常；骨髓切片與抹片為大量嗜酸性球增生並伴隨發育不良的巨核細胞（核分離），符合慢性嗜酸性球白血病。
features: Low-power peripheral blood with markedly increased eosinophils
Eosinophils with uneven, sparse or clumped orange granules, degranulated areas, cytoplasmic vacuoles and hypolobated or ring-like nuclei
Hypercellular marrow with sheets of eosinophils and eosinophilic myelocytes; decreased erythroid precursors
Aspirate: eosinophil precursors with mixed basophilic-staining and eosinophilic granules
Dysplastic megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated nuclear lobes; graph shows rapid fall in eosinophil % and absolute count after ruxolitinib
65203.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked eosinophilia, with many eosinophils displaying dysplastic features including uneven granulation, partial degranulation, cytoplasmic vacuoles and abnormal nuclear lobation. The bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular with marked eosinophilic proliferation and decreased erythropoiesis, and aspirate smears show eosinophilic precursors and dysplastic megakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes. The accompanying graph documents a rapid decline in eosinophil percentage and absolute eosinophil count following JAK1/2 inhibitor therapy. In the setting of clonal cytogenetic abnormalities and a JAK1 mutation without tyrosine kinase fusions, findings are consistent with chronic eosinophilic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils can be degranulated or vacuolated, so morphology alone is not decisive; demonstration of clonality (karyotype, NGS) and associated megakaryocytic dysplasia establishes a neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 fusion
ddx.vs: These must be excluded by FISH/RNA fusion or optical genome mapping, which showed no tyrosine kinase rearrangement here.
L-HES shows an aberrant T-cell population (e.g., CD3-CD4+) on flow cytometry with polyclonal myeloid cells, and no aberrant T cells were identified here.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: MDS/MPN-SF3B1-T has ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis but lacks marked eosinophilic proliferation and shows erythroid hyperplasia rather than decreased erythropoiesis.

65075.recognize_zh: 左下方巨噬細胞的細胞質內擠滿許多小橢圓形蟲體，每隻都有一個紫色核和旁邊一條深色短棒狀的動基體（kinetoplast），這是利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（amastigote）的關鍵特徵；中間有一顆顆粒散出的嗜酸性球，右上是一個正染性紅血球母細胞。
features: Macrophage (lower left) with an oval nucleus and cytoplasm filled with numerous small oval organisms, each about 2-4 microns
Each amastigote shows a round purple nucleus and a separate small dark rod-shaped kinetoplast
Adjacent eosinophil with orange-red granules spilling around the nucleus (disrupted cell)
Orthochromatic erythroblast with dense pyknotic nucleus and grey-pink cytoplasm (right)
Low-density field with scattered RBCs; smear appears to be bone marrow aspirate
65075.describe_en: Aspirate smear at relatively low magnification shows a macrophage whose cytoplasm contains numerous small oval intracellular organisms. At higher inspection each organism has a round nucleus and a distinct, smaller rod-shaped kinetoplast oriented perpendicular to it, without a surrounding capsule or clear halo. A disrupted eosinophil with dispersed orange granules and an orthochromatic erythroblast are present nearby. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (visceral leishmaniasis).

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo-like pseudocapsule and a single eccentric nucleus but no kinetoplast, and are GMS/PAS positive.
T. cruzi amastigotes also have a kinetoplast but are usually found in cardiac or smooth muscle cells rather than marrow macrophages, with epidemiology and PCR required for separation.
T. marneffei yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and lack a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma organisms are crescent-shaped with a single nucleus and no kinetoplast.

65139.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中一群 CD20 強表現、SSC 偏高的 B 細胞，同時 CD11c、CD103、CD25 共表現且為 lambda 限制；右下角周邊血中的淋巴細胞有淡藍色細胞質與周緣絨毛狀突起，符合毛細胞白血病（hairy cell leukemia）。
features: Flow: CD19+ B-cell population (CD5-negative gate) with bright CD20 and relatively increased side scatter
Flow: lambda light-chain restriction (lambda 96% vs kappa 4% within gate)
Flow: co-expression of CD11c (bright), CD103 and CD25 on the clonal population
Morphology: medium-sized lymphocytes with oval to slightly indented nuclei and moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Morphology: moderate pale blue-grey cytoplasm with irregular, fine hair-like circumferential projections
65139.describe_en: Composite figure of peripheral blood flow cytometry and cell morphology. Gating on CD45-positive lymphocytes identifies a CD19-positive, CD5-negative B-cell population with bright CD20 and increased side scatter, lambda light-chain restriction, and co-expression of CD11c, CD103 and CD25. The accompanying Wright-stained cell gallery shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with oval nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and ample pale blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential cytoplasmic projections. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-variant cells have a prominent nucleolus and are typically CD25-negative and CD123/annexin A1-negative, whereas this population co-expresses CD25 and the cells lack prominent nucleoli.
SMZL villous lymphocytes show polar short projections and usually lack the CD103+/CD25+/bright CD11c triad seen here.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL may express CD103 but is usually CD25-negative and CD123-negative, with BRAF V600E absent, unlike classic HCL.

64499.recognize_zh: 兩個中型淋巴樣細胞，圓核、染色質均勻，細胞質淡而多，整圈邊緣伸出細長不規則的毛狀突起（hairy projections），這是毛細胞白血病（hairy cell leukemia）的典型外觀。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than a small lymphocyte
Round to oval central nucleus with homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin and no prominent nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale grey-blue cytoplasm
Fine, irregular circumferential cytoplasmic projections (hairy margins)
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis, including ovalocytes and occasional target-like forms
Leukocytes otherwise scant in this field
64499.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a moderate amount of pale cytoplasm bearing fine, circumferential hair-like projections. Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with circulating hairy cells; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent central nucleolus and are CD25 and CD123 negative with wild-type BRAF.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar villi concentrated at one or both poles rather than circumferential fine projections, and are usually CD103 negative.
Artifactual cytoplasmic fraying is seen in thick smear areas and affects many cells, whereas hairy cells have abundant pale cytoplasm and are confirmed by flow cytometry.

64563.recognize_zh: 左上是核分三葉、顆粒稀疏的嗜酸性球；下方兩個圓核偏位的大細胞，一個充滿橘紅色嗜酸性顆粒、一個充滿深藍紫色顆粒，即周邊血出現的嗜酸性骨髓細胞，提示異常嗜酸性球增多。
features: Eosinophil with three nuclear lobes and reduced, unevenly distributed granules (upper left)
Eosinophilic myelocyte with an eccentric round nucleus and abundant coarse orange-red granules (lower left)
Adjacent myelocyte-sized cell with a round eccentric nucleus and cytoplasm filled with dark blue-purple granules (lower right), consistent with an immature eosinophil with basophilic granules
Precursors are larger than mature granulocytes with moderate cytoplasm
Background red cells unremarkable; scattered platelets
64563.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating eosinophil precursors, including an eosinophilic myelocyte with a round eccentric nucleus and abundant orange-red granules and an adjacent myelocyte-stage cell whose cytoplasm is filled with dark blue-purple granules. A mature eosinophil in the upper left shows nuclear hyperlobation and hypogranulation. Findings are suggestive of a clonal eosinophilic disorder, such as a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA rearrangement, requiring genetic confirmation.

ddx.vs: Basophil precursors have larger, sparse, water-soluble dark granules overlying the nucleus, whereas immature eosinophil granules are uniform and packed, and the paired orange-granulated myelocyte favors eosinophil lineage.
Reactive states rarely release eosinophilic myelocytes into blood and show normally granulated bilobed eosinophils.
Abnormal eosinophils in inv(16) are accompanied by increased myelomonocytic blasts and CBFB::MYH11, which must be excluded genetically.

64435.recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀中有兩群 CD19 陽性 B 細胞：紅色小群為 CD5+、CD20 弱、λ 輕鏈限制的殘存 CLL；黑色較大群為 CD10+、CD45 弱、κ 表現，並呈連續成熟曲線的 hematogones。κ 看似「單株」是因 daratumumab（IgG1κ）結合 CD38 陽性細胞造成的偽象。
features: Panel A: marrow CD20 IHC highlights an interstitial and aggregated B-cell infiltrate
Panel B: CD138 IHC highlights clusters of plasma cells
Panel C: CD19-gated B cells split into a red CD5+/CD10- lambda-restricted cluster (residual CLL)
Black CD19+/CD10+ population with low SSC and continuous CD10/CD19 maturational spread typical of hematogones
Black population appears kappa-positive on the kappa/lambda plot, reflecting bound daratumumab (IgG1 kappa) rather than clonality
64435.describe_en: Bone marrow immunostains show a CD20-positive B-cell infiltrate and CD138-positive plasma cell aggregates from the earlier specimen. Post-treatment flow cytometry demonstrates two CD19-positive populations: a small CD5-positive, CD10-negative, dim CD20, lambda-restricted population representing residual chronic lymphocytic leukemia, and a larger CD10-positive, CD45-dim, low side-scatter population with a normal maturational pattern consistent with hematogones. The hematogones display apparent kappa light chain expression, attributable to surface-bound daratumumab (IgG1 kappa) on CD38-expressing precursors. Findings are consistent with residual lambda-restricted CLL and regenerating hematogones with therapy-related spurious kappa staining, without evidence of a new CD10-positive B-cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts show asynchronous, clustered antigen expression that deviates from the normal hematogone maturation continuum (e.g. aberrant CD58, CD38, CD10 intensity).
Follicular lymphoma cells are CD20-bright, surface light chain-restricted and CD45-bright, whereas hematogones are CD45-dim, CD20-negative/variable immature precursors.
A true clone shows kappa expression with a compact phenotype and clonal IG rearrangement, whereas only one lambda IG rearrangement was detected here.
Myeloma plasma cells are CD38/CD138-bright, CD19-negative, CD45-negative with cytoplasmic lambda, not CD10+ B-cell precursors.

64179.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血液中一顆淋巴樣細胞，核偏向一側、染色質中度凝集，一側有較寬的深藍色細胞質，呈漿細胞樣（plasmacytoid lymphocyte）外觀；這種介於淋巴球與漿細胞之間的形態，是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤（Waldenström）的線索。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell, about 1.5 times red cell diameter
Eccentric round-to-oval nucleus with moderately condensed, patchy chromatin
Moderate amount of basophilic cytoplasm, broader on one side (plasmacytoid)
No distinct perinuclear hof or prominent nucleolus
Background red cells normocytic, some with prominent central pallor
64179.describe_en: High-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized lymphoid cell with an eccentric nucleus, moderately condensed patchy chromatin, and a moderate amount of basophilic cytoplasm concentrated on one side, giving a plasmacytoid appearance. A perinuclear hof and prominent nucleolus are not seen. The background red cells are normocytic. Findings are consistent with a circulating plasmacytoid lymphocyte, in keeping with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma in the context of IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

ddx.vs: Mature plasma cells have coarse clock-face chromatin, deeper basophilic cytoplasm, and a well-defined perinuclear hof, and are CD19-negative/CD138-positive.
Reactive forms occur among a heterogeneous population of reactive lymphocytes and are polyclonal.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein favor LPL, whereas villous lymphocytes and splenic presentation favor SMZL.

64115.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片左側一顆大型組織球，胞質豐富呈泡沫狀、邊緣不規則，裡面包著數顆完整的分葉顆粒球，其中一顆外圍有透明暈圈（在吞噬泡內）；組織球吞噬完整的造血細胞，是 HLH 的噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant, finely vacuolated, irregularly bordered cytoplasm
Several intact segmented granulocytes engulfed within the cytoplasm, one surrounded by a clear phagocytic halo
Engulfed cells retain recognizable nuclear lobation, indicating recent phagocytosis
Adjacent smudged/degenerating cell and an immature granulocytic cell with basophilic cytoplasm
Background of red cells in a thick area of the smear
64115.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant, finely vacuolated cytoplasm containing several intact, engulfed segmented granulocytes, one lying within a clear phagocytic vacuole. Adjacent are a degenerating smudged cell and an immature granulocytic precursor. The finding represents hemophagocytosis. Hemophagocytosis in marrow is supportive but neither sensitive nor specific for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, so the diagnosis requires the clinical and laboratory criteria (HLH-2004 or HScore), such as fever, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, and soluble CD25.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific hemophagocytosis after transfusion, infection, or chemotherapy
ddx.vs: Occasional hemophagocytic histiocytes are morphologically identical and common in stressed marrow; HLH requires fulfilling clinical/laboratory criteria.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil-engulfing macrophage vs. phagocytosis of apoptotic debris
ddx.vs: Tingible-body macrophages contain fragmented nuclear debris rather than whole intact cells as seen here.
Overlapping cells lie in a different focal plane without a surrounding clear vacuole, whereas engulfed cells here sit within the histiocyte cytoplasm with a halo.
Histiocytic sarcoma shows sheets of cytologically atypical histiocytes with pleomorphic nuclei rather than a bland histiocyte with benign-appearing phagocytosed cells.

63923.recognize_zh: 四格骨髓切片對照：H&E 可見擴張的竇狀隙內塞滿小至中型、核深染的淋巴球；CD3 與 TCR-delta 染色都呈現分支狀、沿竇狀隙分布的陽性細胞群，而 TCR-beta 陽性細胞稀少且不呈竇狀隙分布，表示竇內浸潤為 γδ T 細胞，符合肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: A (H&E): dilated marrow sinusoids filled with small to intermediate lymphoid cells with dark, slightly irregular nuclei among hypercellular hematopoiesis
B (CD3): positive cells in branching, cord-like intrasinusoidal clusters distributed throughout the marrow
C (TCR-delta): the same branching intrasinusoidal pattern as CD3, indicating gamma-delta T cells
D (TCR-beta): only scattered positive cells with a non-sinusoidal distribution
Background hematopoiesis with erythroid precursors and large megakaryocyte-like cells is preserved
63923.describe_en: This four-panel composite of a bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with preserved hematopoiesis in which dilated sinusoids are filled by small to intermediate atypical lymphoid cells with dark, mildly irregular nuclei (A). CD3 immunostaining highlights these cells in a branching, intrasinusoidal pattern (B), which is mirrored by TCR-delta staining (C), while TCR-beta labels only scattered, non-sinusoidal T cells (D). The intrasinusoidal infiltrate is therefore composed of gamma-delta T cells. In a young male with hepatosplenomegaly and cytopenias, the findings are consistent with hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma involving the marrow; isochromosome 7q and trisomy 8 are supportive when present but were not detected in this case.

ddx.vs: T-LGL is usually alpha-beta CD8+ with granzyme/TIA-1 and forms small linear intrasinusoidal clusters with neutropenia and without the marked hepatosplenomegaly and diffuse sinusoidal gamma-delta infiltration.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia is surface CD3 and TCR negative, EBER positive, and has larger granular cells.
Intravascular LBCL consists of large CD20+ B cells within vessels and sinusoids, not small CD3+ TCR-delta+ T cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive sinusoidal T-cell infiltrate (e.g. infection or hemolytic stress)
ddx.vs: Reactive T cells are polyclonal, predominantly alpha-beta and sparse, without a monomorphic TCR-delta+ sinusoidal population or clonal TCR gamma rearrangement.

63731.recognize_zh: 箭頭處是一顆圓形細胞，胞質被密集的深紫黑色嗜鹼性（metachromatic）顆粒完全填滿、邊緣呈毛刺狀，中央可見淡染的圓形細胞核，這是正常骨髓肥大細胞的典型樣子；顆粒不像嗜鹼性球那樣覆蓋分葉核。
features: Round-oval cell with centrally placed, round, relatively pale nucleus (arrow)
Cytoplasm densely packed with coarse dark purple-black metachromatic granules extending to a fuzzy cell border
Granules do not obscure a lobulated nucleus (distinguishing from basophil)
Well-granulated, round (not spindled) morphology indicating a normal mast cell
Adjacent granulocytes (eosinophilic granulated cell, band neutrophil), small lymphocyte and monocytoid cell for size comparison
63731.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a single round mast cell (arrow) with a centrally placed round nucleus and cytoplasm densely filled with coarse, dark purple-black metachromatic granules that extend to the cell border. The cell is well granulated and round rather than spindled or hypogranular. Surrounding cells include granulocytes at various stages, a small lymphocyte and red cells. Findings are consistent with a normal-appearing marrow mast cell.

ddx.vs: Basophils are smaller with a segmented nucleus overlain by fewer, larger granules, whereas mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus and densely packed granules.

ddx.dx: Atypical mast cell of systemic mastocytosis
ddx.vs: Neoplastic mast cells are spindle-shaped, hypogranular with eccentric oval or bilobed nuclei and form aggregates, and express CD25.
Eosinophil granules are larger, refractile and orange-red rather than dark purple-black metachromatic.
Abnormal promyelocytes have azurophilic granules, Auer rods and bilobed nuclei with visible cytoplasmic outline, not a solid granule-packed round cell.

63667.recognize_zh: 周邊血（A、B）可見大型異常細胞，細胞質充滿粗大深紫色嗜鹼性顆粒且核呈雙葉；骨髓抹片（C）見大量含異染性顆粒、外形不規則的肥大細胞；切片（D）為紡錘形細胞片狀浸潤，CD117 與 tryptase 強陽性、CD25 部分陽性。
features: PB (A, B): large atypical cells with abundant coarse dark purple granules partly obscuring bilobed or irregular nuclei
BM aspirate (C): numerous atypical mast cells with dense metachromatic granules, irregular to spindled outlines, some hypogranular
BM biopsy H&E (D): sheets of spindled cells with oval to elongated nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm next to a bone trabecula
IHC (E-G): diffuse strong CD117 and tryptase; weaker, partial CD25
Multipanel composite
63667.describe_en: Multipanel composite. The peripheral blood smear (A, B) shows circulating large atypical cells with abundant coarse, dark purple cytoplasmic granules and bilobed or irregular nuclei. The bone marrow aspirate (C) contains numerous atypical mast cells with dense metachromatic granules, irregular and focally spindled contours, and variable hypogranularity. The core biopsy (D) shows a dense paratrabecular and interstitial infiltrate of spindled mast cells that are diffusely positive for CD117 (E) and tryptase (F) with partial CD25 expression (G). With mast cells exceeding 20% of aspirate cells, circulating mast cells, and KIT D816V, findings are consistent with mast cell leukemia.

ddx.dx: Basophilic leukemia or CML with basophilia
ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented nuclei with water-soluble granules and are CD117 negative with weak tryptase and no CD25, unlike these CD117/tryptase-strong spindled mast cells.
Hypergranular promyelocytes have azurophilic granules and Auer rods, are strongly MPO positive, and are tryptase negative.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with associated hematologic neoplasm (non-leukemic)
ddx.vs: Non-leukemic SM has mast cells below 20% of aspirate nucleated cells.
Myelomastocytic leukemia has metachromatic blasts in a myeloid neoplasm without SM criteria such as dense tryptase-positive aggregates, CD25, or KIT D816V.

63667.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD117, tryptase, CD25

63539.recognize_zh: 鼻腔黏膜下有瀰漫的中小型、核形不規則且深染的非典型淋巴細胞浸潤，旁邊合併壞死（星號）；免疫染色 CD3、CD2、CD56、TIA-1、granzyme B 陽性、CD20 陰性，EBV 原位雜交細胞核陽性，符合結外 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤，鼻型。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of small to intermediate atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei and pale cytoplasm (arrow)
Adjacent zone of coagulative necrosis with fibrin and karyorrhectic debris (asterisk)
Admixed inflammatory cells and extravasated red cells; vascular structures within the infiltrate
IHC panels: tumor cells positive for CD3 (membranous/cytoplasmic), CD2, CD7 and CD56, with granular granzyme B and TIA-1; CD20 negative
EBV in situ hybridization panel shows dark nuclear signals in the tumor cells
63539.describe_en: H&E section of nasal turbinate mucosa shows a diffuse submucosal infiltrate of small to intermediate-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei and pale cytoplasm (arrow), with an adjacent zone of necrosis (asterisk) and mixed inflammatory cells. On immunohistochemistry the atypical cells express CD3, CD2, CD7 and CD56, with granular cytotoxic granule staining for TIA-1 and granzyme B, and are negative for CD20. EBV in situ hybridization shows diffuse nuclear positivity in the tumor cells. Findings are consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

ddx.vs: GPA shows geographic necrosis with palisading histiocytes, giant cells and vasculitis, with a polymorphous reactive infiltrate lacking CD56+ EBER+ atypical cells, and ANCA positivity.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of sinonasal tract
ddx.vs: DLBCL is composed of large CD20+ PAX5+ B cells, whereas this infiltrate is CD20 negative with a cytotoxic CD3/CD56 phenotype.
PTCL-NOS is usually EBER negative and lacks the combination of CD56, cytotoxic markers and angiocentric necrosis.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia presents with systemic marrow and blood involvement and fulminant course, while this is a localized nasal mass; clinical staging distinguishes them.

63539.stain: H&E; IHC: CD3, CD20, CD2, CD56, CD7, TIA-1, GzmB; ISH: EBER

63283.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中大部分有核細胞為中大型芽細胞：核質比高、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，胞質淡藍而少，箭頭所指的芽細胞核有凹摺，成熟顆粒球與紅系細胞稀少，符合 AML。
features: Predominance of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to oval nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with one or more small nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Occasional nuclear indentation or folding in arrowed blasts
Few maturing granulocytes and scattered small erythroid precursors; fat vacuoles and red cells in background
63283.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (high power) is dominated by medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm; some blasts show nuclear indentations (arrows). Auer rods are not identified in this field. Maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements are markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; assignment to AML with myelodysplasia-related changes requires multilineage dysplasia assessment, a history of MDS, or defining cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts tend to be smaller with scant cytoplasm and less conspicuous nucleoli, and are MPO-negative and TdT/CD19 or CD3 positive by flow cytometry.
Monoblasts and promonocytes have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, delicate folded nuclei and are NSE-positive with CD14/CD64 expression.
NPM1-mutated blasts often show cup-like nuclear invaginations and are CD34-negative with cytoplasmic NPM1, which requires IHC or molecular testing to exclude.

63027.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片紅血球明顯大小不一，許多為大型卵圓形紅血球（macro-ovalocytes），並有淚滴狀等異形；高倍下可見一個核分葉達 6 葉以上的過度分葉嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil），這兩個線索合起來指向巨母紅血球性貧血，如惡性貧血。
features: Hypersegmented neutrophil with six or more nuclear lobes (B)
Macro-ovalocytes: large oval red cells lacking central pallor
Marked anisocytosis and poikilocytosis, including teardrop and fragmented forms
Decreased red cell density on low power consistent with anemia (A)
Platelets present, not clumped; no nucleated red cells or blasts in these fields
63027.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) at low power shows decreased red cell density with marked anisopoikilocytosis (A). At higher power, many red cells are macro-ovalocytes, with occasional teardrop and fragmented forms, and a neutrophil with six or more nuclear lobes is present (B). Platelets are present without obvious clumping, and no blasts or nucleated red cells are identified in these fields. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia; in the context provided, pernicious anemia (autoimmune B12 deficiency) should be confirmed with vitamin B12, methylmalonic acid, and anti-intrinsic factor antibody studies.

ddx.vs: Folate deficiency produces an identical smear; it is separated by serum/red cell folate and a normal methylmalonic acid level.
MDS may show macrocytes but typically has hypogranular, hyposegmented (pseudo-Pelger) neutrophils rather than hypersegmentation, and normal B12/folate levels.
These produce round rather than oval macrocytes, often with target cells or stomatocytes, and no hypersegmented neutrophils.
Morphology can be identical, so medication history and normal vitamin levels are the discriminators.

62963.recognize_zh: 出生第 8 天的超活體染色（A）幾乎每顆紅血球膜邊都附著多個藍色 Heinz 小體；同期 Wright 染色（B）可見許多皺縮、邊緣不規則帶棘突的密集紅血球（pyknocytes，箭頭），到 2 個月（C）時明顯減少，符合嬰兒期 pyknocytosis 合併氧化性傷害。
features: Supravital stain at 8 days (A): numerous blue, membrane-associated Heinz bodies in the majority of red cells, often multiple per cell
Wright-stained smear at 8 days (B): many pyknocytes, i.e. small, dense, irregularly contracted red cells with multiple short spiny projections (arrows)
Gallery (D): pyknocytes with crenated/irregular outlines, bite- or blister-like indentations and denser hemoglobin
Smear at 2 months (C): fewer irregular cells, most red cells now normal biconcave discs with central pallor
Scattered platelets; no parasites or schistocyte predominance
62963.describe_en: Composite figure. A supravital preparation at 8 days of life shows Heinz bodies in most red cells as blue inclusions attached to the inner membrane. The corresponding Wright-stained smear shows numerous pyknocytes, which are dense, contracted red cells with irregular spiculated outlines and occasional bite- or blister-like defects. By 2 months, the proportion of pyknocytes has fallen and most cells show normal central pallor. Findings are consistent with infantile pyknocytosis with prominent oxidative red cell injury, a transient neonatal hemolytic anemia.

ddx.vs: G6PD deficiency shows bite and blister cells with Heinz bodies after oxidant exposure; low G6PD activity on enzyme assay (repeated after reticulocytosis settles) separates it.

ddx.dx: Hereditary elliptocytosis / pyropoikilocytosis in the neonate
ddx.vs: HPP shows microspherocytes, fragments and budding cells with low MCV and a positive EMA binding/thermal fragility test, persisting beyond infancy.
Unstable hemoglobins produce Heinz bodies that persist after the neonatal period, with abnormal isopropanol stability test and globin sequencing.
Echinocytes have evenly spaced regular projections on normal-density cells and no Heinz bodies, whereas pyknocytes are dense with irregular spicules.

62899.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向一個淡染的紅血球，其內有一條細而彎曲的紫色線橫越細胞，即 Cabot 環（Cabot ring）；周圍可見骨髓系各階段前驅細胞（myelocyte、metamyelocyte、band）、多個有核紅血球與明顯的紅血球變形，符合 CML 伴紅系病態造血的背景。
features: Arrowed pale red cell containing a thin, curved purple-staining line looping across the cell (Cabot ring)
Left-shifted granulocytic series: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented neutrophils
Several nucleated red cells with small dense pyknotic nuclei
Marked poikilocytosis with fragmented, elongated, and irregular red cells
Crowded leukocytes with a hypolobated/abnormal neutrophil nucleus in the upper field
62899.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a left-shifted granulocytic series including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band forms, and segmented neutrophils, accompanied by several nucleated red cells with dense pyknotic nuclei. Red cells show marked anisopoikilocytosis with fragments and elongated forms. The arrowed pale red cell contains a thin, curved, purple-staining filament looping across the cell, consistent with a Cabot ring, a finding associated with dyserythropoiesis. In a patient with confirmed BCR::ABL1, findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia with dysplastic erythroid features and a Cabot ring.

ddx.vs: Ring forms have a discrete chromatin dot with a thin cytoplasmic ring and are smaller, rather than a thread-like loop or figure-of-eight spanning the red cell.
Shows small rings, often multiple or in tetrads (Maltese cross), without the fine continuous filament of a Cabot ring.

ddx.dx: Red cell overlapping or crenation artifact
ddx.vs: Edges of overlapping cells or folds are refractile outlines, not purple-staining filaments within the cell.
Round, dense purple nuclear remnants rather than a thin ring or loop.

62835.recognize_zh: 骨小樑內有一個被挖空的吸收腔（Howship's lacuna / tunnelling），腔壁整圈排列著多核、胞質粉紅的蝕骨細胞（osteoclasts），腔內為疏鬆纖維性基質，這種「隧道狀骨吸收合併旁小樑纖維化」是副甲狀腺亢進／腎性骨病變（osteitis fibrosa）的典型表現。
features: Thick bony trabecula with a central resorption cavity (tunnelling/dissecting resorption)
Cavity lined circumferentially by numerous large multinucleated osteoclasts with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm sitting in scalloped Howship's lacunae
Cavity filled with loose, pale fibrillary/edematous fibrous stroma containing scattered small cells
Adjacent marrow at lower left with fat cells and hematopoietic elements
Paratrabecular loose fibrous tissue along the right trabecular surface
62835.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section (photographed through the eyepiece) shows a thick bony trabecula containing a large internal resorption cavity. The cavity is lined circumferentially by numerous multinucleated osteoclasts occupying scalloped Howship's lacunae and is filled with loose fibrous stroma, representing dissecting (tunnelling) resorption. Adjacent paratrabecular loose fibrosis is present, and the nearby marrow contains fat and hematopoietic cells. In a patient with chronic renal failure, the findings are consistent with renal osteodystrophy with secondary hyperparathyroidism (osteitis fibrosa).

ddx.vs: Bone histology is identical; separation relies on serum calcium (high in primary, low-normal in secondary) and renal function.
Paget disease has very large osteoclasts with many nuclei plus a mosaic pattern of irregular cement lines and osteoblastic rimming, rather than tunnelling resorption with paratrabecular fibrosis.
Tumor-associated osteolysis shows osteoclasts adjacent to sheets of plasma cells or carcinoma cells, not a cavity filled by bland fibrous stroma.
Myelofibrosis shows diffuse reticulin/collagen fibrosis with atypical megakaryocyte clusters and osteosclerosis rather than osteoclast-rich resorption cavities.

62771.recognize_zh: 腹部 CT 顯示腎臟腫大、增強不均並有浸潤性低密度區（箭頭）；腎臟切片中瀰漫性的淋巴細胞浸潤把腎小管撐開，但腎絲球本身保留未被侵犯，是淋巴瘤浸潤腎間質的型態。
features: CT: enlarged kidney with heterogeneous enhancement and infiltrative hypodense areas (arrows)
Renal core: diffuse, sheet-like interstitial infiltrate of atypical lymphoid cells
Infiltrate separates and replaces tubules, with residual tubules mainly at the periphery of the core
Glomeruli preserved and not infiltrated by tumor cells (inset)
Cytologic detail limited at this magnification; no ancillary stains shown
62771.describe_en: Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT shows an enlarged kidney with heterogeneous enhancement and ill-defined infiltrative hypodense areas (arrows). The renal core biopsy shows a diffuse, sheet-like interstitial infiltrate of atypical lymphoid cells that separates and effaces the tubules, while the glomeruli are preserved and not involved by the infiltrate. Detailed cytology cannot be assessed at this magnification and no immunostains or cytogenetic studies are shown. In context, findings are consistent with diffuse renal interstitial involvement by high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rearrangements, with sparing of glomeruli.

ddx.vs: Interstitial nephritis shows a mixed inflammatory infiltrate with eosinophils, edema, and tubulitis rather than a monotonous sheet of atypical lymphoid cells replacing tubules.

ddx.dx: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma involving kidney
ddx.vs: IVLBCL fills glomerular and peritubular capillaries, whereas this infiltrate is interstitial with glomeruli spared.

ddx.dx: Renal involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Histology may be identical, so separation requires FISH for MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rearrangements.
These show polymorphous plasma cell-rich infiltrates, storiform fibrosis, or clinical transplant context rather than a monomorphic high-grade lymphoid sheet.

62707.recognize_zh: 這張是周邊血液的細胞化學染色（推測為 MPO）：左上方成熟顆粒球胞質內充滿藍黑色陽性顆粒可作為內部陽性對照，兩個大型、染色淡、邊緣呈新月形折疊的細胞則幾乎無陽性顆粒（右側一個僅有少數顆粒），代表大部分原始細胞為陰性，需搭配流式判定混合表型。
features: Mature granulocyte with dense, coarse blue-black cytoplasmic reaction product (internal positive control)
Two large cells with pale pink cytoplasm, weak counterstain and a crescent-shaped fold, lacking reaction product
One large cell with only a few focal blue-black granules at the periphery
Red cells show fine punctate dots, likely stain precipitate or artifact
Nuclear detail is poorly visualized with this counterstain, limiting morphologic assessment
62707.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained with a cytochemical stain (likely myeloperoxidase with a blue-black chromogen) shows a mature granulocyte with strong, coarse granular positivity serving as an internal control. Two large cells with pale cytoplasm and folded contours, presumed blasts, are essentially negative, with only rare focal granules in one cell. Nuclear detail is not well seen with the counterstain, and fine dots over red cells are likely artifact. Cytochemistry therefore shows at most a minor MPO-positive blast subset; in the context of mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid, myeloid lineage assignment rests on flow cytometric MPO expression in a defined blast population together with B-lineage markers.

ddx.vs: Blasts are MPO-negative by cytochemistry and flow, whereas MPAL B/myeloid requires MPO positivity in a subset of blasts (or monocytic differentiation) along with strong CD19 and other B-cell markers.
Blasts are MPO-negative or <3% positive by cytochemistry but lack B-lineage commitment markers such as strong CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10.
Shows stronger and more frequent MPO positivity with nonspecific esterase-positive monocytic cells, and B-cell markers are absent.

62643.recognize_zh: 紅血球 CD59 分型圖：橫軸 FL2 為 CD59 表現量，依強度分成正常第 I 型（57.66%）、部分缺失第 II 型（1.93%）與完全缺失第 III 型（40.42%），顯示紅血球有大型 PNH 克隆（約 42%）。
features: Dot plot of FL2 (x, GPI-linked CD59) versus FL1 (y, red cell marker) on gated red cells
Type I (normal CD59 expression, red): 57.66%
Type II (partial CD59 deficiency, green): 1.93%
Type III (complete CD59 deficiency, black): 40.42%
Total PNH red cell clone (type II + III) approximately 42%
62643.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of gated red blood cells displays FL1 versus FL2 intensity, with FL2 representing expression of the GPI-anchored protein CD59. Red cells separate into type I cells with normal CD59 expression (57.66%), type II cells with partial deficiency (1.93%) and type III cells with complete deficiency (40.42%). The combined PNH red cell population of about 42% indicates a large PNH clone. Because PNH red cells are preferentially hemolyzed and may be diluted by transfusion, the red cell clone size can underestimate the true clone, which is better reflected by granulocyte and monocyte FLAER analysis. Findings are consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria.

ddx.vs: Isolated inherited CD59 deficiency affects all red cells uniformly with preserved other GPI-anchored proteins and FLAER binding on leukocytes.

ddx.dx: Small PNH clone in aplastic anemia or MDS
ddx.vs: Typically shows clones well below 10% rather than a type III population of 40%.

ddx.dx: Technical artifact from poor staining or recent transfusion
ddx.vs: Artifactual loss is diffuse rather than forming discrete type II/III populations, and must be confirmed by FLAER on granulocytes and monocytes.

62579.recognize_zh: MUM1 免疫染色：生發中心內的大型漿母細胞樣細胞呈中等強度的核陽性，周圍密集的小淋巴球大多為陰性；顯示這些 HHV8 陽性大細胞具有漿細胞分化（post-germinal center）表型，符合親生發中心淋巴增生性疾病。
features: Moderate nuclear MUM1/IRF4 staining in large plasmablastic cells
Positive cells have abundant pale cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei with nucleoli
Positive large cells arranged in loose clusters within a follicular compartment
Admixed small lymphocytes are predominantly negative
Weak non-specific cytoplasmic blush in some large cells
62579.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for MUM1/IRF4 shows moderate nuclear staining in the large plasmablastic cells, which form loose clusters within a follicular compartment, while the admixed small lymphocytes are largely negative. The positive cells have vesicular nuclei, visible nucleoli and abundant pale cytoplasm. MUM1 expression indicates a post-germinal center/plasmablastic phenotype of the HHV8-infected cells. In conjunction with HHV8 LANA-1 and EBER positivity and a germinal-center-restricted distribution, the findings are consistent with HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma is also MUM1+ but forms diffuse sheets effacing the tissue and is HHV8 LANA-1 negative.
In HHV8+ MCD MUM1+ plasmablasts are scattered in mantle zones of Castleman-type follicles and are EBV negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia with plasma cells
ddx.vs: Reactive MUM1+ cells are small mature plasma cells and a minor subset of late germinal-center B cells, lacking HHV8 and forming no large-cell clusters.

62515.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀的點狀圖，已圈選 CD19+ B 細胞，X 軸為 lambda、Y 軸為 kappa；B 細胞集中為單一族群，kappa 表現弱（約 10^3），lambda 為陰性，沒有分開的 lambda+ 族群，代表表面輕鏈微弱且單一型（dim kappa），符合 CLL。
features: Dot plot gated on CD19+ B cells: lambda-PE (x-axis) versus kappa-FITC (y-axis)
Single tight population with dim kappa expression (~10^3) and negative lambda
No separate lambda-positive population, so normal polytypic kappa:lambda distribution is absent
Overall weak surface light chain intensity
62515.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on CD19-positive B cells displays kappa versus lambda surface light chain expression. The B cells form a single cluster with dim kappa and negative lambda staining, without a discrete lambda-positive subset. This pattern indicates a monotypic kappa-restricted B-cell population with dim surface immunoglobulin; interpretation assumes appropriate negative controls. Findings are consistent with a clonal B-cell process such as chronic lymphocytic leukemia, which characteristically shows dim surface light chain expression.

ddx.vs: MCL also is CD5-positive but usually shows moderate-to-bright surface light chain, CD23 negativity, FMC7/CD20 bright, and cyclin D1 or t(11;14).
Polyclonal B cells show two distinct kappa and lambda populations with a normal kappa:lambda ratio of roughly 1.5-2:1.
Truly sIg-negative populations (e.g., hematogones, some DLBCL) lie on the axis origin without kappa shift, and require cytoplasmic light chain or other markers for clonality.

62451.recognize_zh: 這是中期分裂相 FISH（DAPI 藍色背景）：9 號與 22 號染色體各剩單一紅/綠訊號，der(9) 與 Ph 染色體上各有一個 BCR::ABL1 融合訊號（2F1R1G），另見 del(7q) 探針的藍綠紅訊號分布於 7 號染色體與 dic(7;12)，12 號著絲點紅訊號在正常 12 號與 dic(7;12) 上，說明 t(9;22) 合併 dic(7;12)。
features: Metaphase FISH with DAPI-counterstained blue chromosomes and labeled arrows
BCR/ABL1 dual-color dual-fusion probe: single red (ABL1) signal on normal chromosome 9, single green (BCR) signal on normal chromosome 22
One red-green fusion signal each on der(9) and the Philadelphia chromosome, giving a 2F1R1G pattern of t(9;22)
CEP12 red signals on normal chromosome 12 and on the dic(7;12)
Del(7q) triple-color probe: aqua, red and green signals on normal chromosome 7 and on dic(7;12), indicating the 7q region is retained on the dicentric
Non-morphologic cytogenetic image; interpretation relies on probe design and signal localization
62451.describe_en: Metaphase FISH using a BCR/ABL1 dual-color dual-fusion probe combined with a chromosome 12 centromere enumeration probe and a 7q deletion probe shows a 2F1R1G BCR/ABL1 pattern, with one fusion signal on der(9) and one on the Philadelphia chromosome, and residual single ABL1 and BCR signals on the normal chromosomes 9 and 22, respectively. The CEP12 probe shows two signals, one on the normal chromosome 12 and one on a dic(7;12). The 7q probe shows the full aqua-red-green signal set on both the normal chromosome 7 and the dic(7;12), indicating that the targeted 7q region is not deleted. These findings confirm a BCR::ABL1 rearrangement from t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) together with a dic(7;12), consistent with the accompanying karyotype.

ddx.vs: Variant t(9;22) involving a third chromosome shows fusion signals on additional or different chromosomes and atypical signal patterns.
Loss of sequences at the der(9) breakpoint leaves only one fusion signal, unlike the two fusions seen here.
Monosomy 7 or del(7q) would show loss of one set of 7q probe signals, whereas both sets are present here.

62323.recognize_zh: 兩顆相鄰的中型母細胞，核圓至腎形、染色質細緻，細胞質淡灰藍色；右側細胞在細胞質邊緣可見一顆小的嗜天青顆粒，這種偶見顆粒的未分化母細胞可見於 BPDCN，但需免疫表型確認。
features: Two adjacent medium-sized blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio
Left cell: round to slightly kidney-shaped nucleus with moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm
Right cell: oval nucleus with fine, slightly granular chromatin and a thin rim of cytoplasm
Single small azurophilic granule at the upper right cytoplasmic margin of the right-hand cell
No Auer rods, vacuoles or nucleoli clearly visible
62323.describe_en: High-power view of the aspirate smear shows two medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin and pale gray-blue cytoplasm; the left cell has a slightly reniform nucleus with more abundant cytoplasm, and the right cell has an oval nucleus with a thin cytoplasmic rim. The right-hand cell contains a single small azurophilic granule at the cytoplasmic margin. No Auer rods or vacuoles are present. The cells are morphologically nonspecific blasts; rare azurophilic granules do not exclude blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, which requires confirmation by CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4 and TCL1 expression with negative MPO.

ddx.vs: AML blasts may contain several granules or Auer rods and are MPO or CD13/CD33/CD117-positive, whereas BPDCN blasts are MPO-negative with a CD123bright/TCF4-positive profile.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have more abundant gray cytoplasm with fine granules and folded nuclei, and express CD14/CD64/lysozyme rather than TCF4/TCL1.
LGLs are mature cells with condensed chromatin and several coarse azurophilic granules in abundant cytoplasm, not blasts with fine chromatin.

62131.recognize_zh: 上排血液抹片可見卵圓形巨紅血球、淚滴狀與碎片紅血球；下排可見核分葉過多（hypersegmented）的嗜酸性球，其中部分細胞顆粒稀疏、像是顆粒外漏，提示維生素 B12/葉酸缺乏的巨母細胞性貧血。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with oval macrocytes, teardrop cells, fragments and microcytes (Ai-ii)
A large macrocyte with an irregular internal inclusion or ring-like structure (Aii)
Eosinophils with coarse orange granules and hypersegmented nuclei of four or more lobes (Bi-ii)
Multilobed granulocytes with sparse, pale or unevenly distributed granules suggesting degranulated eosinophils (Biii-iv)
Hypersegmentation involving the eosinophil lineage in addition to neutrophil-sized cells
62131.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (A) shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with oval macrocytes, teardrop cells, red cell fragments and microcytes, and a large macrocyte containing an irregular inclusion. High-power views (B) show eosinophils with coarse eosinophilic granules and hypersegmented nuclei, together with multilobed granulocytes whose granules are sparse or unevenly distributed, suggesting partial degranulation of hypersegmented eosinophils. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia with hypersegmentation extending to eosinophils; serum B12, folate, methylmalonic acid and homocysteine should be measured.

ddx.vs: MDS shows hypogranular pseudo-Pelger-Huet neutrophils with hypolobation rather than hypersegmentation, and does not correct with vitamin replacement.
Inherited hypersegmentation occurs with normal MCV and red cell morphology, unlike the oval macrocytes and poikilocytosis here.
Morphology is identical, so separation depends on medication history with normal B12 and folate levels.
Neutrophils have fine lilac granules, whereas residual coarse orange granules identify these multilobed cells as eosinophils.

62067.recognize_zh: 與右下方正常小淋巴球相比，中央這顆異常淋巴球明顯較大，細胞核有深刻迂迴的腦回狀（cerebriform）皺褶與溝紋，周圍有中等量淡藍色細胞質，是典型的 Sézary 細胞。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cell, roughly 2-3 times the diameter of the adjacent small lymphocyte
Convoluted nucleus with deep grooves and folds producing a cerebriform contour
Moderately condensed chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Normal mature small lymphocyte and normocytic red cells in the background for size comparison
62067.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large atypical lymphoid cell, approximately two to three times the size of a normal small lymphocyte present in the same field. The nucleus is markedly convoluted with deep grooves imparting a cerebriform appearance, the chromatin is moderately condensed, and nucleoli are not conspicuous. There is a moderate amount of pale blue, agranular cytoplasm. Background red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a Sézary cell; diagnosis of Sézary syndrome requires erythroderma, lymphadenopathy, and a clonal circulating CD4+ T-cell population with loss of CD7 and/or CD26 by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells have multilobated petal-like nuclei with basophilic cytoplasm and are HTLV-1 associated, whereas Sézary cells show folded grooved cerebriform nuclei without discrete lobes.
T-PLL cells are medium-sized with a single prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, lacking the deep cerebriform convolutions.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells with a round or mildly indented nucleus rather than a cerebriform nucleus.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles, and lack the dense convoluted lymphoid chromatin.

62003.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中幾乎每顆細胞都呈淡紅色核對比染色，細胞質周圍有瀰漫性深藍色顆粒狀訊號，呈片狀一致陽性；這種單一型態、一致陽性的染色提示漿細胞輕鏈限制（可能為 kappa 或 lambda 原位雜交），但探針未標示，無法從此圖直接判讀 cyclin D1。
features: Sheet of densely packed cells with nuclear fast red-type pink counterstain
Diffuse fine blue-black granular cytoplasmic signal surrounding most cells
Uniform positivity across the field, suggesting a monotypic population
No normal hematopoietic architecture discernible in this field
Probe/antigen not labeled; cytologic detail limited by the chromogen
62003.describe_en: Section of bone marrow shows a dense sheet of cells stained with a chromogenic in situ hybridization or immunostain (dark blue chromogen with pink nuclear counterstain; probe not labeled). Nearly all cells in the field show fine granular cytoplasmic signal, indicating a diffuse, monotonous population. In the context of plasma cell myeloma, this pattern is most consistent with light chain mRNA in situ hybridization demonstrating light-chain restriction in a plasma cell infiltrate; the image itself does not demonstrate cyclin D1 expression, which would be nuclear, and the specific probe should be verified in the referenced case.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells show a mixture of kappa- and lambda-positive cells (roughly 2:1) rather than uniform positivity with one probe.
MCL is CD5+/CD20+/SOX11+ lymphoid B cells without CD138 or cytoplasmic light chain mRNA, while t(11;14) myeloma is CD138+ with monotypic cytoplasmic light chain.
LPL has a small B-cell component with MYD88 L265P and fewer monotypic plasma cells, not a sheet of uniformly positive plasma cells.

61939.recognize_zh: IgD染色下一個大結節由密集的IgD陽性小B細胞（外套區細胞）構成，陽性細胞從周邊一路侵入中央、只剩淡染的生發中心殘塊，而旁邊的小濾泡外套區則維持環狀，是PTGC的經典免疫染色表現。
features: Large nodule densely populated by IgD-positive small B cells (mantle-zone cells)
IgD-positive cells extend from the periphery into the center, leaving only pale IgD-negative germinal center remnants
Adjacent normal-sized follicles show a thin intact IgD-positive mantle ring
Scattered IgD-positive cells in the interfollicular areas and around vessels
61939.describe_en: IgD immunostain shows a markedly enlarged nodule densely populated by IgD-positive small mantle B cells that extend from the periphery into the center, fragmenting the IgD-negative germinal center. Nearby follicles retain a thin circumferential IgD-positive mantle zone around their germinal centers. The infiltration of an enlarged germinal center by IgD-positive mantle cells is characteristic of progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules also contain IgD+ small B cells but harbor scattered large LP cells with CD20/OCT2/BOB1 expression and PD1+ T-cell rosettes, and replace the node diffusely.
MCL mantle cells are IgD-positive too but are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, CD5-positive and monotypic, forming expanded mantles or diffuse sheets.
FL follicles have attenuated or absent IgD+ mantles and BCL2+ germinal centers rather than mantle cells infiltrating the center.

61875.recognize_zh: 高倍下原始細胞核質比高、染色質細緻、核仁不明顯，少量深藍色胞質邊緣有成串的明顯空泡，形態酷似 Burkitt 細胞；這是 T 淋巴母細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（T-ALL/LBL）的空泡變異，須靠免疫表型確認。
features: Medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and round to slightly irregular nuclei
Finely dispersed immature chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Prominent, sharply defined cytoplasmic vacuoles, often clustered at the cell periphery
Occasional smudged cells and a residual neutrophil in the background
61875.describe_en: High-power view of the smear shows a population of medium-sized blasts with high nucleus-to-cytoplasm ratios, round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed immature chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The scant cytoplasm is deeply basophilic and contains prominent, sharply punched-out vacuoles, frequently arranged along the cell periphery. Scattered smudged cells and a rare neutrophil are present. These Burkitt-like features are not lineage specific; with flow cytometry showing a CD3-, CD1a- and CD4/CD8-positive immature T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with cytoplasmic vacuolation.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells show similar basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are TdT-negative mature B cells with surface light chain restriction and MYC rearrangement.
B-ALL can be vacuolated but expresses CD19, cytoplasmic CD79a and CD22 rather than cytoplasmic CD3.
Myeloblasts often show azurophilic granules or Auer rods and express MPO, CD13, CD33 or CD117, which are absent in these blasts.

61811.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見兩顆中型未成熟細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻，細胞質深藍無顆粒，其中一顆核有凹陷或摺疊，另一顆有細胞質泡突，屬於循環母細胞（可能帶單核球分化）。
features: Two intermediate-sized immature mononuclear cells with high N:C ratio
Finely dispersed chromatin; one nucleus with an indentation/fold
Deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm, one cell with a cytoplasmic bleb
No Auer rods identified
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis and occasional ovalocytes; platelets sparse
61811.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two circulating immature mononuclear cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, an indented nucleus in one cell, and a rim of deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with a cytoplasmic bleb. Auer rods are not seen. Background red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional ovalocytes, and platelets are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with circulating blasts, possibly with monocytic features, in a myeloid neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and more condensed chromatin without blast-like fine chromatin.
Lymphoblasts usually have scantier cytoplasm and are separated by immunophenotype (CD19, CD10, TdT) rather than reliably by morphology.
BPDCN cells may show cytoplasmic pseudopods and vacuoles and are CD4+/CD56+/CD123+ and MPO-negative on flow.

61747.recognize_zh: H&E 中可見一團多形性淋巴細胞浸潤，含中至大型非典型細胞，緊鄰大片粉紅色壞死區；非典型淋巴浸潤合併地圖狀壞死是淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫的常見組合。
features: Nodular polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate with medium to large atypical cells
Atypical cells with enlarged irregular nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes and histiocytes
Adjacent broad zones of eosinophilic necrosis with ghost cells
No well-formed granulomas or multinucleated giant cells in this field
61747.describe_en: Sections show a nodular polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate containing medium to large atypical cells with irregular nuclei, admixed small lymphocytes and histiocytes, bordered by extensive eosinophilic necrosis. Well-formed granulomas, giant cells, and neutrophilic microabscesses are not identified in this field, and a vessel wall is not clearly seen. The combination of an atypical polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate and necrosis is consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, pending CD20/EBER confirmation.

ddx.vs: GPA shows basophilic geographic necrosis with neutrophils, palisading histiocytes, and giant cells without EBER-positive atypical B cells.
CHL contains CD30/CD15-positive HRS cells in a mixed inflammatory background with eosinophils rather than CD20-positive EBV-infected B cells.
ENKTL shows angiocentric necrosis with atypical CD56/cytoplasmic CD3-positive cells that are CD20-negative.

61683.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（側散射 SS 對 CD7），非形態影像；閘門內 98.66% 的細胞為 CD7 陽性，主要藍色族群 CD7 表現強（約 10^2），符合 T-PLL 常見的 CD7 強陽性。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD7-APC700 (x-axis, log) versus side scatter intensity (y-axis, linear), gate labeled [AZ]
Rectangular region annotated CD7+ : 98.66% of gated events
Dominant blue population with low side scatter (below about 250) and bright CD7 expression centred near 10^2
Smaller red, magenta and green subsets with dimmer CD7 extending toward the negative region
Small green/magenta CD7-negative population with low side scatter at the left
61683.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot shows CD7 expression versus side scatter within the gated population. Nearly all gated events (98.66%) fall within the CD7-positive region, with the dominant low side scatter population (blue) expressing bright CD7, while a minor population shows dim to negative CD7. The low side scatter indicates lymphoid cells without cytoplasmic granularity. Strong CD7 expression on an expanded T-cell population is characteristic of T-prolymphocytic leukemia and helps distinguish it from Sezary syndrome and ATLL, which usually lose CD7.

61555.recognize_zh: 移植病人淋巴結中，大型非典型淋巴細胞以血管為中心呈袖套狀浸潤（perivascular cuffing），周圍是大片凝固性壞死；需配合 CD20、CD30 與 EBER 陽性判定為 EBV 陽性 PTLD（單形性，DLBCL 型）。
features: Angiocentric cuff of atypical lymphoid cells surrounding a small vessel with a thickened hyalinized wall
Cells are medium to large with irregular, angulated nuclei, vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant to moderate cytoplasm; admixed small lymphocytes at the periphery of the cuff
Surrounding extensive eosinophilic geographic necrosis with scattered ghost cells and extravasated red cells
Normal nodal architecture not recognizable in this field
61555.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows effacement by extensive geographic necrosis with a preserved perivascular cuff of viable atypical lymphoid cells around a small hyalinized vessel. At high power the cells are predominantly large with irregular, angulated nuclei, vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, admixed with a few small lymphocytes. In the post-transplant setting with PAX5/CD20 and CD30 positivity, CD15 negativity and diffuse EBER positivity, findings are consistent with EBV-positive post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, monomorphic type (diffuse large B-cell lymphoma).

ddx.vs: LYG is an angiocentric, angiodestructive EBV+ B-cell process of lung and extranodal sites in a mostly T-cell–rich background, whereas this is a nodal sheet-like large B-cell proliferation in a transplant recipient.

CHL-type PTLD shows scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD15+, CD30+ with weak PAX5 and CD20 negative, in contrast to these confluent large cells brightly expressing CD20 and lacking CD15.
Polymorphic PTLD contains a full spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasma cells and immunoblasts without sheets of monotonous large transformed cells.
It is also angiocentric, necrotic and EBER+, but the cells are CD3ε+, CD56+ and CD20−.

61491.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見數個巨核細胞（megakaryocyte），其中三個聚在一起，細胞大、細胞質豐富嗜酸性、核分葉正常且無明顯異型，背景為紅血球系與顆粒球系前驅細胞；巨核細胞數量增加但型態成熟正常，符合 ITP 的周邊破壞型血小板減少。
features: Several megakaryocytes, including a loose cluster of three, indicating increased numbers
Megakaryocytes are large with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and normally lobulated nuclei
No hypolobated, small dysplastic, or bizarre hyperchromatic megakaryocytes
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with erythroid precursors (round dark nuclei) and granulocytic cells
Interspersed fat spaces; section quality shows some processing artifact and uneven staining
61491.describe_en: Bone marrow section shows cellular hematopoietic marrow with interspersed fat spaces. Megakaryocytes appear increased, including a small loose cluster, and are large with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and normally lobulated nuclei, without dysplastic or bizarre hyperchromatic forms. Erythroid and granulocytic precursors are present in the background, and no infiltrative process is seen in this field, although section quality limits fine cytologic detail. Findings are consistent with a peripheral consumptive thrombocytopenia such as immune thrombocytopenia, in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are also increased and large but hyperlobulated (staghorn) with a high platelet count and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation, rather than thrombocytopenia.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated, or have separated nuclear lobes, with dysplasia in other lineages.
PMF megakaryocytes form tight clusters with bulbous, hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei and are associated with reticulin fibrosis.
Aplastic anemia or congenital amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia shows reduced or absent megakaryocytes, the opposite of this field.

61427.recognize_zh: 細胞豐富的骨髓抹片中，視野中央一顆巨噬細胞胞質內與周圍聚集許多小型卵圓形紫色小體（Leishman-Donovan bodies），符合利什曼原蟲感染。
features: Cellular marrow smear with a central macrophage containing a cluster of numerous small oval purple organisms
Organisms uniform, about 2-4 um, concentrated around the macrophage nucleus
Kinetoplast not distinctly resolved at this magnification
Surrounding trilineage hematopoiesis including granulocytic precursors, erythroblasts, lymphocytes and a plasma cell
Occasional smudged cells and stretched nuclear strands from smearing
61427.describe_en: Cellular bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and a plasma cell. In the center, a macrophage contains a cluster of numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular organisms. Their internal nucleus and kinetoplast are not clearly resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies of Leishmania, supporting visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a surrounding clear halo, lack a kinetoplast and stain with GMS/PAS.
Talaromyces yeasts are more elongated with a central septum and lack a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic with a single nucleus and no kinetoplast.

61363.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞的核膜已消失，濃縮的染色體呈放射狀排列（中期分裂相，正面觀），細胞質淡藍；旁邊兩個淋巴瘤細胞核輪廓不規則、細胞質少，在乾淨的腦脊髓液背景中顯示為高增殖的淋巴瘤細胞。
features: Mitotic figure (arrow) with condensed chromosomes arranged radially in a metaphase rosette, no nuclear membrane
Mitotic cell with moderate pale blue cytoplasm and blebbed outline
Two adjacent medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours
Atypical cells with fine to slightly coarse chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Paucicellular, clean cytospin background
61363.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a paucicellular specimen containing a small group of atypical cells. One cell is in metaphase, with condensed chromosomes arranged in a radial rosette and no nuclear membrane. The adjacent cells are medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours, blastoid chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm. In a patient with known blastoid mantle cell lymphoma, findings are consistent with CNS involvement by lymphoma; flow cytometry of the CSF is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphocytes in CSF (e.g., viral meningitis)
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are polymorphous with mature chromatin and mitoses are rare; flow cytometry shows no light-chain restriction.
Lymphoblasts have finer chromatin and very high N:C ratio and are TdT-positive, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT-negative and cyclin D1-positive.
