Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with abundant cytoplasm and are keratin-positive rather than dispersed lymphoid cells.

61299.recognize_zh: 組合圖：A 骨髓抹片中為大量母細胞（實線箭頭），另有一團深染、互相黏附的細胞群（虛線箭頭）；B 骨髓切片細胞密度高，可見與造血組織不同的病灶區；C 核染色免疫染色把成群的腫瘤細胞染成棕色，顯示癌轉移與白血病並存。
features: Panel A: aspirate smear with sheets of monotonous blasts (solid arrow)
Panel A: dense, dark-staining cohesive cell cluster (dashed arrow) distinct from blasts, consistent with a metastatic tumor clump
Panel B: hypercellular marrow biopsy with a blast-rich infiltrate and a focal area of different texture (dashed arrow)
Panel C: nuclear immunostain (antibody not labeled) highlighting cohesive nests of tumor cells amid negative leukemic marrow
Low-resolution composite limits cytologic detail
61299.describe_en: This composite figure shows a bone marrow aspirate (A) composed predominantly of monotonous blasts (solid arrow), with a separate dense, cohesive clump of dark-staining cells (dashed arrow). The core biopsy (B) is hypercellular and largely replaced by a blast-rich infiltrate, with a focal area of different morphology (dashed arrow). An immunostain with nuclear positivity (C; antibody not specified) highlights cohesive nests of tumor cells within otherwise negative marrow. Findings are consistent with concurrent acute myeloid leukemia and metastatic breast carcinoma; the specific markers (e.g., GATA3 or ER for carcinoma, CD34/MPO for blasts) should be confirmed.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocyte clusters or aspirate particle artifact
ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are single large cells with granular cytoplasm and are CD61-positive, whereas carcinoma clusters are cohesive nests positive for keratin, GATA3, or ER.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related myeloid neoplasm after breast cancer treatment
ddx.vs: This is a clinical distinction based on prior chemotherapy or radiation and cytogenetics such as KMT2A rearrangement or complex karyotype, not morphology.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma alone with reactive changes
ddx.vs: Absence of CD34/MPO-positive blast sheets and a normal blast count would exclude concurrent leukemia.

61171.recognize_zh: H&E 切片中是一片單一形態的漿細胞樣細胞，細胞核圓且偏位、染色質呈車輪狀（clock-face），細胞質雙染性，少數細胞可見核旁淡染區（hof）與雙核細胞，片狀取代正常組織，符合漿細胞瘤（plasmacytoma）。
features: Diffuse sheets of monomorphic plasma cells separated by thin fibrovascular septa
Medium-sized cells with round, eccentrically placed nuclei
Coarsely clumped cartwheel (clock-face) chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous in most cells
Moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm; perinuclear hof visible in only a subset of cells
Occasional binucleate forms; no admixed small lymphocytes, germinal centers or significant mitotic activity
61171.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of monomorphic plasma cells separated by delicate fibrovascular septa. The cells have round eccentric nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; a perinuclear hof is appreciable in only a minority of cells, and occasional binucleate forms are present. There is no significant admixture of small lymphocytes or reactive follicles. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm (plasmacytoma); CD138 and kappa/lambda immunostains or ISH to confirm clonality and evaluation to exclude plasma cell myeloma are recommended.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL contains a substantial component of small B cells and monocytoid cells, often colonizing follicles, with CD20-positive cells, unlike this pure plasma cell sheet.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has large cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent central nucleoli and high mitotic and Ki-67 index, often EBER positive.
Reactive plasma cells are polyclonal on kappa/lambda staining and are mixed with lymphocytes and other inflammatory cells rather than forming monomorphic sheets.

ddx.dx: Neuroendocrine tumor or metastatic carcinoma with plasmacytoid cells
ddx.vs: Plasmacytoid carcinoma/neuroendocrine cells grow in nests or trabeculae and are cytokeratin/synaptophysin positive and CD138 variably positive but light-chain negative.

61107.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片中大量真皮小血管內腔被大型異型淋巴細胞塞滿（E），血管內皮標記呈環狀勾勒出血管壁（C），另一染色則強染血管腔內成團腫瘤細胞（D），周邊組織相對少浸潤，符合血管內大細胞淋巴瘤（NK/T 細胞型）。
features: Low power (A): dermis with ill-defined cellular foci and edema beneath the epidermis
Medium power (B): numerous small dermal vessels near a hair follicle distended by cells
High power (E): large atypical lymphoid cells with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei confined within vascular lumina
IHC (C): endothelial marker outlines numerous vessels, confirming the intraluminal location of the cells
Stain (D): strong labeling of the intravascular tumor cell clusters with little extravascular positivity (marker not labeled; EBER/NK-T marker expected)
61107.describe_en: Composite figure of a skin biopsy. At low and medium power, the dermis contains numerous small vessels that appear distended and hypercellular, with only a limited extravascular infiltrate. At high power the vascular lumina are filled by large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei. An endothelial immunostain outlines the vessel walls around the tumor cells, and a second stain strongly highlights the intravascular tumor cell aggregates. With EBV (EBER) positivity and an NK/T-cell phenotype, the findings are consistent with intravascular large cell lymphoma of NK/T-cell type, EBV positive.

ddx.vs: IVLBCL shares the intraluminal pattern but expresses CD20/PAX5 and is EBV negative, lacking cytotoxic markers and CD56.
ENKTL forms angiocentric and angiodestructive mass-like infiltrates with necrosis rather than cells confined to vessel lumina.
Leukostasis involves circulating leukemia with a corresponding peripheral blood and marrow picture, not EBER-positive NK/T cells confined to small vessels.
These contain CD68-positive histiocytes or proliferating endothelial cells rather than atypical lymphoid cells.

61043.recognize_zh: 周邊血的「母細胞」體積大、核不規則且有凹陷（類似花瓣狀核），骨髓切片為瀰漫中大型母細胞樣細胞；CD20 膜陽性、cyclin D1 核陽性、MYC/BCL6 陽性且 Ki-67 極高，提示合併 MYC、BCL6 重組的母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤，而非急性白血病。
features: Peripheral blood with large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented to lobated ('flower-like') nuclei
Fine chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm mimicking blasts
Bone marrow biopsy: diffuse sheets of medium-to-large blastoid cells with vesicular nuclei and scattered apoptotic bodies
IHC: strong membranous CD20; nuclear MYC and BCL6 positivity
Nuclear cyclin D1 positivity and very high Ki-67 (>95%)
61043.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood contains large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented to lobated nuclei and fine chromatin that closely mimic blasts. The bone marrow biopsy shows diffuse replacement by medium-to-large blastoid cells with scattered apoptotic bodies. Immunohistochemistry shows the neoplastic cells to be CD20-positive with nuclear expression of cyclin D1, MYC and BCL6 and a Ki-67 index exceeding 95%. With FISH-confirmed CCND1, MYC and BCL6 rearrangements, findings are consistent with blastoid mantle cell lymphoma with triple-hit rearrangements.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are TdT/CD34 or MPO positive and cyclin D1-negative, whereas these cells are mature CD20+ cyclin D1+ B cells.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2/BCL6 rearrangements
ddx.vs: HGBL lacks cyclin D1 expression and IGH::CCND1.

ddx.dx: Pleomorphic variant of MCL or DLBCL
ddx.vs: Cyclin D1/SOX11 positivity and CCND1 rearrangement separate MCL from DLBCL; blastoid vs pleomorphic is a morphologic distinction of monotonous lymphoblast-like vs larger pleomorphic cells.

61043.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, IHC: CD20, MYC, BCL6, cyclin D1, Ki-67

60979.recognize_zh: 紅血球之間可見一條由細小深藍色菌體排成的短鏈，位於細胞外、與紅血球同一焦平面；右下角嗜中性球已退化、細胞質空泡化並散出細小顆粒，提示周邊血中有游離細菌（菌血症）。
features: Short chain of small, uniform, deeply basophilic organisms lying extracellularly between red cells
Organisms in the same focal plane as surrounding red cells, supporting true in vivo presence
Degenerating neutrophils (lower right) with vacuolated cytoplasm and scattered small dark particles nearby
Red cells normochromic with mild anisocytosis; no other specific abnormality
60979.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a short chain of small, uniform, deeply basophilic bacteria lying free between red cells in the same focal plane. Nearby neutrophils are degenerated with vacuolated cytoplasm and adjacent small dark particles. Red cell morphology is otherwise unremarkable. Findings are consistent with free bacteria on the peripheral smear, indicating high-grade bacteremia; Gram stain and blood culture are required for organism identification, and contamination should be excluded.

ddx.vs: Contaminating bacteria are often out of focal plane, overlie cells randomly and are unaccompanied by toxic or phagocytic neutrophil changes; negative blood culture supports contamination.
Precipitate is irregular, refractile and variably sized rather than uniform organisms arranged in a chain.
Spirochetes are long, thin, loosely coiled extracellular organisms many times the length of a red cell, not short beaded chains.
Platelets are larger with granular centers, and Howell-Jolly bodies are single round inclusions inside red cells.

60915.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞內與背景中散布大量 2–4 微米的小卵圓形微生物，每顆有一個圓形核及旁邊棒狀的動基體（kinetoplast），即利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（Leishman-Donovan bodies）。
features: Low power: cellular aspirate particle with mixed hematopoietic cells and clusters of small inclusions
Numerous small oval organisms (approximately 2–4 µm) clustered within and around macrophages
High power: each amastigote with a round nucleus and adjacent small rod-shaped kinetoplast
Large macrophage with cytoplasm packed with amastigotes; free (extracellular) organisms from ruptured cells
Panel D: few organisms in a sparsely cellular field adjacent to red cells; staining is pale in this panel
60915.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show cellular particles with mixed hematopoietic elements and numerous macrophages. Many small oval organisms, each with a round nucleus and a small rod-shaped kinetoplast, are present within macrophage cytoplasm and scattered extracellularly. Occasional organisms are also seen in less cellular areas. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies) and support a diagnosis of visceral leishmaniasis; confirmation by PCR, culture or serology is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are similar in size but have a clear halo and lack a kinetoplast, and are GMS/PAS positive.
Yeasts divide by a central transverse septum and lack a kinetoplast.
Tachyzoites are crescent-shaped without a kinetoplast.
Platelets are granular, irregular and lack the discrete nucleus-plus-kinetoplast structure.

60851.recognize_zh: 左下方是由小淋巴球組成、界線清楚的反應性淋巴濾泡，其周圍的淋巴竇內可見一條淡粉紅色帶狀區域，充滿胞質淡嗜酸、核卵圓帶核溝的蘭格漢斯細胞並夾雜少數嗜酸性球，符合濾泡周竇的 LCH 侵犯。
features: Well-circumscribed lymphoid follicle/mantle of densely packed small lymphocytes at bottom left
Perifollicular sinus band of pale eosinophilic lesional cells running diagonally from upper left to right
Lesional cells with moderate pale cytoplasm and oval, grooved or folded nuclei with fine chromatin
Scattered eosinophils and small lymphocytes admixed within the sinus infiltrate
Additional lymphoid tissue at the upper right; no significant atypia or necrosis
60851.describe_en: Hematoxylin and eosin-stained section of lymph node at higher power shows a reactive lymphoid follicle at the bottom left surrounded by a perifollicular sinus that is expanded by pale histiocytoid cells. The lesional cells have moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval, grooved or folded nuclei with fine chromatin, admixed with scattered eosinophils and small lymphocytes. No marked atypia or necrosis is seen. Findings are consistent with sinusoidal involvement by Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman sinus histiocytes are larger with round nuclei, prominent nucleoli and emperipolesis, and are CD1a/langerin negative.
Reactive sinus histiocytes have bland round-to-oval nuclei without grooves or eosinophils and are CD1a negative.
Dermatopathic change forms paracortical nodules with melanin pigment rather than sinus-confined sheets.

60595.recognize_zh: 紅血球之間可見一條細長、規則螺旋捲曲的游離螺旋菌（spirochete），長度約為紅血球直徑的 1–2 倍，位於細胞外，這是回歸熱疏螺旋體（Borrelia）在周邊血液抹片的典型表現。
features: Single thin, loosely coiled, extracellular spirochete lying in the plasma between red cells
Organism length roughly 1-2 red cell diameters with several regular spiral turns
Neutrophil with a band-like/segmented nucleus in the field
Red cells show mild anisocytosis without intracellular parasites
60595.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a thin, helically coiled, extracellular spirochete in the plasma between erythrocytes, measuring approximately one to two red cell diameters in length. A neutrophil is present; red cells show mild anisocytosis without intraerythrocytic inclusions. In the appropriate clinical setting of recurrent fevers, findings are consistent with relapsing fever borreliosis (Borrelia hermsii); organisms are most numerous during febrile episodes and may be missed between them.

ddx.vs: Fibrin strands are straight or branching and irregular, lacking the regular spiral coils and tapered ends of a spirochete.
Microfilariae are much larger (many red cell diameters long) with nuclear columns, not thin spirals.
Trypanosomes are broader, with an undulating membrane, a nucleus, a kinetoplast and a flagellum.
Leptospira are finer, tightly coiled with hooked ends and are rarely visible on Wright-stained blood smears.

60659.recognize_zh: 採血管內整管血液呈暗紅褐色、上層看不到正常血漿；抹片中幾乎找不到完整的紅血球，只剩淡淡的紅血球殘影，嗜中性球細胞質內有吞噬物的空泡（吞噬紅血球），提示敗血症（如產氣莢膜梭菌）造成的大量血管內溶血。
features: Panel A: blood collection tube with uniformly dark red-brown, lacquer-like contents and no visible separation of normal plasma, indicating massive hemolysis
Panels B–C: smear background almost devoid of intact red cells, with only faint pale red cell ghosts
Neutrophil with vacuolated cytoplasm containing phagocytosed pale material consistent with ingested red cells or red cell remnants (erythrophagocytosis)
Second leukocyte (panel C) largely occupied by clear vacuoles with ingested material
Small platelet clump; no organisms are clearly identified at this magnification
60659.describe_en: The blood sample is grossly dark red-brown and uniformly hemolyzed. The peripheral blood smear shows near-complete absence of intact red cells, with only faint red cell ghosts in the background, and neutrophils containing cytoplasmic vacuoles with phagocytosed red cell material. No bacteria are definitively seen at this magnification. Findings are consistent with massive intravascular hemolysis with erythrophagocytosis in the setting of severe sepsis, a pattern classically associated with Clostridium perfringens alpha-toxin; urgent blood cultures are indicated.

ddx.vs: Artifactual hemolysis leaves pink plasma over intact red cells on the smear, whereas here red cells are nearly absent and neutrophils show erythrophagocytosis.
AIHA shows spherocytes and a positive DAT with a preserved red cell mass on the smear rather than wholesale lysis to ghosts.
Malaria-associated hemolysis shows intraerythrocytic ring forms or gametocytes and pigment in leukocytes.
HLH shows hemophagocytosis mainly by macrophages in marrow or tissue with cytopenias and hyperferritinemia, not acute complete red cell lysis in the blood tube.

60723.recognize_zh: 嗜中性球核呈兩個圓形葉以細絲相連的「夾鼻眼鏡」（pince-nez）狀，染色質粗塊狀，而細胞質顆粒正常；骨髓中大多數成熟嗜中性球同樣呈雙葉或不分葉，且無其他造血異常，符合良性遺傳性 Pelger-Huët 異常。
features: Neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus: two round, dense lobes joined by a thin chromatin strand (pince-nez/spectacle form) (A)
Markedly coarse, clumped mature chromatin
Normal volume of pale cytoplasm with normal fine neutrophilic granulation (no hypogranularity)
Bone marrow aspirate (B): most band and segmented-stage neutrophils are bilobed or peanut-shaped with clumped chromatin; orderly maturation of myelocytes and metamyelocytes and an eosinophil present
No blast increase or dyserythropoiesis evident in the field; background red cells unremarkable
60723.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with bilobed, spectacle-shaped nuclei composed of two round lobes connected by a thin chromatin filament, with coarsely clumped chromatin and normally granulated cytoplasm. The bone marrow aspirate demonstrates orderly granulocytic maturation in which the majority of mature neutrophils are bilobed or non-lobed with similar chromatin condensation, without hypogranulation, increased blasts or other dysplasia in the field. Findings are consistent with Pelger-Huët anomaly; the uniform involvement of neutrophils and absence of dysplasia favor the benign inherited (LBR-related) form, which can be confirmed by family studies.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Pelger cells involve only a subset of neutrophils and are accompanied by hypogranulation, cytopenias, dysplasia in other lineages or a clonal abnormality.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced pseudo-Pelger change (e.g., tacrolimus, mycophenolate, taxanes)
ddx.vs: Drug-related hyposegmentation appears after exposure and resolves on withdrawal, whereas the inherited anomaly is lifelong and familial.
Band neutrophils have a C-shaped nonconstricted nucleus with less clumped chromatin and coexist with toxic changes in infection.
Homozygotes show predominantly round, non-lobed (Stodgy) nuclei in nearly all neutrophils rather than the bilobed pince-nez forms of heterozygotes.

captions: Peripheral blood: bilobed pince-nez neutrophil with clumped chromatin
Bone marrow aspirate: many hyposegmented mature neutrophils with normal maturation

60531.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色（未標示抗體）中，散在的大細胞呈細胞質與膜狀棕色陽性，這些細胞核卵圓淡染、細胞質豐富並向外延伸，型態像類上皮組織球；周圍大量小至中型淋巴樣細胞為陰性。
features: IHC with brown DAB chromogen and hematoxylin counterstain; antibody not labeled
Scattered larger cells with abundant cytoplasm showing granular cytoplasmic and membranous positivity
Positive cells have oval to elongated pale vesicular nuclei and cytoplasmic extensions, resembling epithelioid histiocytes
Intervening small-to-medium cells with irregular nuclei are negative
No cohesive sheets of positive cells; positive cells are dispersed
60531.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymphoid lesion shows scattered large cells with abundant cytoplasm and oval pale nuclei displaying granular cytoplasmic and membranous positivity, distributed among a dense population of negative small-to-medium lymphoid cells. The morphology of the positive cells favors histiocytes, but the antibody is not specified and the stained population cannot be definitively assigned from the image. In the context of the title, the image highlights the numerous interspersed epithelioid histiocytes characteristic of lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) lymphoma, a variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma rich in histiocytes
ddx.vs: Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30+/CD15+ PAX5-weak Reed-Sternberg cells, which should be sought on a CD30 stain.
THRLBCL has scattered large CD20+ B cells within a histiocyte and T-cell background, whereas Lennert lymphoma has atypical T cells without large B cells.
Reactive granulomas form discrete aggregates without an atypical clonal T-cell population.

60467.recognize_zh: Ki-67 免疫染色下，大量中至大型腫瘤細胞呈細胞核強陽性，粗估約一半以上的腫瘤細胞為陽性且分布無極性，顯示高增殖指數，符合高級別濾泡性淋巴瘤（3B 級）。
features: Numerous tumor nuclei with strong nuclear Ki-67 staining
Positive cells are medium to large with round to irregular nuclei
Estimated proliferation index roughly 50-60% in this field, without zonal polarization
Negative small cells and spindle stromal cells interspersed
Architecture (follicle boundaries) not evaluable at this magnification
60467.describe_en: Ki-67 immunohistochemical stain shows strong nuclear positivity in a large proportion of medium to large neoplastic cells, estimated at roughly half or more of tumor cells in this field, distributed without the polarized pattern of a reactive germinal center. Interspersed small cells and stromal cells are negative. The high proliferation index supports a high-grade follicular lymphoma and, with sheets of centroblasts, is consistent with follicular lymphoma, grade 3B; Ki-67 alone does not substitute for centroblast counting in grading.

ddx.vs: Low-grade FL typically has a Ki-67 index below 20-30%, although some cases show discordantly high proliferation.
Reactive germinal centers have very high Ki-67 with a polarized dark-zone/light-zone distribution and are BCL2-negative.
Burkitt lymphoma shows a near 100% Ki-67 index in a monotonous medium-sized population, higher than the index seen here.
DLBCL may have a similar proliferation index, so distinction requires demonstrating follicular architecture with CD21/CD23.

60275.recognize_zh: 淋巴結上半部為密集的小淋巴球（CLL/SLL 背景），下半部則是片狀壞死區，充滿核碎裂（karyorrhexis）碎屑、纖維素、出血與散在腫大細胞；在 CLL 病人淋巴結出現這種非乾酪性壞死灶，應在高倍下找 HSV 核內包涵體。
features: Upper zone of densely packed, monotonous small lymphocytes consistent with CLL/SLL
Lower zone of geographic necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris
Fibrinous and edematous background with extravasated red cells and small congested vessels
Scattered enlarged cells with pale, smudged nuclei within the necrotic area
No well-formed granulomas or neutrophilic abscesses at this magnification
60275.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows a dense infiltrate of monotonous small lymphocytes in the upper portion of the field, consistent with the patient's chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma. The lower portion contains a sharply demarcated area of necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic debris, fibrin, hemorrhage and scattered enlarged cells with pale smudged nuclei. No well-formed granulomas or abscesses are identified at this power. Necrosis of this type in a lymph node involved by CLL should prompt a search for viral cytopathic effect; in this case high-power examination showed herpes simplex virus inclusions, confirmable by HSV-1/2 immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Kikuchi shows paracortical necrosis with abundant crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells, no neutrophils and no viral inclusions, typically in young patients without CLL.
Necrosis in Richter transformation is accompanied by sheets of viable large atypical B cells at the edge rather than a small-cell background with viral cytopathic cells.
These show palisading epithelioid histiocytes and giant cells around caseous necrosis, with organisms on AFB or GMS stains.
Lupus shows necrosis with hematoxylin bodies and vasculitis in a clinical setting of SLE, lacking Cowdry inclusions.

60083.recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖中第 3 號染色體對的右側一條以箭頭標示長臂 q21 與 q26 兩處，兩斷點之間的條帶順序顛倒，其餘染色體與性染色體 XY 無明顯異常；這就是 inv(3)(q21q26.2)，牽涉 GATA2 增強子與 MECOM。
features: G-banded karyogram with 22 autosome pairs plus X and Y (male)
Two arrows on the long arm of one chromosome 3 mark breakpoints at 3q21 and 3q26.2
Altered band pattern between the breakpoints indicates a paracentric inversion within 3q
No other numeric or structural abnormality is evident at this resolution
Karyotype interpretation: 46,XY,inv(3)(q21q26.2)
60083.describe_en: G-banded karyogram from the bone marrow shows a male complement with an abnormal chromosome 3, in which arrows mark breakpoints at 3q21 and 3q26.2 with an altered banding pattern consistent with a paracentric inversion of the long arm. No additional numeric or structural abnormalities are evident at this banding resolution, although subtle changes such as monosomy 7 frequently accompany this lesion and should be excluded in all metaphases analyzed. The karyotype is interpreted as 46,XY,inv(3)(q21q26.2), which repositions the GATA2 enhancer to drive MECOM overexpression. This finding defines AML with inv(3)(q21q26.2)/MECOM rearrangement, a high-risk genetic group.

ddx.vs: The balanced translocation involves both chromosome 3 homologs with exchanged segments, whereas an inversion alters only one homolog; both produce the same GATA2-MECOM juxtaposition.
These involve a partner chromosome other than 3 and carry different WHO classification implications.
Comparison with the normal homolog and FISH with a MECOM break-apart probe confirm a true rearrangement.

60019.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片中，有核細胞絕大多數為大小一致、核質比高、染色質細緻、無顆粒的母細胞，成熟顆粒球與紅系前驅細胞極少，並有許多破碎細胞（smudge cells）；母細胞明顯超過 20%，符合急性白血病，系別需靠細胞化學與流式判定。
features: Nucleated cells dominated by a monotonous population of intermediate-sized blasts (approximately 90%)
High N:C ratio with scant agranular pale-blue cytoplasm and fine chromatin
Slightly irregular or angulated nuclear contours
Rare residual neutrophils and small lymphocytes; erythroid precursors sparse
Numerous smudged cells and scattered platelets in the background; no Auer rods evident at this power
60019.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows a cellular specimen in which the vast majority of nucleated cells are monotonous intermediate-sized blasts with high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, slightly irregular nuclear contours, and scant agranular cytoplasm. Residual granulocytes, erythroid precursors, and lymphocytes are rare, and numerous smudged cells are present. Auer rods are not evident at this magnification. The blast proportion far exceeds 20%, establishing acute leukemia; with negative MPO and NSE cytochemistry and no lineage-specific markers on flow cytometry, the findings are consistent with acute undifferentiated leukemia.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts can look identical and are also MPO/NSE negative, but flow cytometry shows B- or T-lineage markers.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 is MPO negative cytochemically but expresses myeloid antigens such as CD13, CD33, or CD117.
Megakaryoblasts may show cytoplasmic blebbing and express CD41/CD61, often with a dry tap from fibrosis.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with smudge cells
ddx.vs: CLL smudge cells occur with small mature lymphocytes having coarse clumped chromatin, not the fine chromatin of these blasts.

23219.recognize_zh: 抹片中大量異常前骨髓球，細胞質充滿紫紅色粗大顆粒、核呈折疊或雙葉狀；放大圖（B）可見一條細長的 Auer 小體橫跨在細胞核上方（箭頭），配合牙齦出血，指向急性前骨髓球性白血病（APL）。
features: Numerous large abnormal promyelocytes with moderate N:C ratio
Folded, reniform or bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Cytoplasm densely packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules, some obscuring the nucleus
Slender Auer rod overlying the nucleus in the highlighted cell (arrow, panel B)
Relative absence of maturing neutrophils; red cells without significant fragmentation in this field
23219.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate/peripheral blood smear shows a predominance of large abnormal promyelocytes with folded to bilobed nuclei and abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules. Normal maturing granulocytes are sparse. At high magnification, a slender Auer rod is seen superimposed over the nucleus of one cell. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type); urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and coagulation studies for DIC are indicated.

ddx.vs: AML with maturation has blasts with a single long Auer rod and salmon perinuclear hof plus maturing granulocytes, rather than sheets of hypergranular promyelocytes with folded nuclei.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocyte-rich marrow (G-CSF effect or marrow recovery)
ddx.vs: Recovering marrow shows normal promyelocytes with a Golgi zone and orderly maturation, without Auer rods or bilobed nuclei.
Monocytic blasts have fine granules, gray-blue cytoplasm and are nonspecific esterase positive, while APL cells show intense MPO positivity and coarse granules.
The microgranular variant has bilobed nuclei with sparse or invisible granules, unlike the heavily granulated cells seen here.

3059.recognize_zh: 這是極低倍數的周邊血抹片，紅血球分布均勻、大小形狀看起來一致，看不到鐮刀型或標靶細胞；此解析度無法辨識細部形態，HbS/HPFH 的診斷需靠血紅素電泳/HPLC 與 HbF 分布（pancellular）而非形態。
features: Very low-power field of evenly spread red cells of fairly uniform size
No sickle cells, target cells or red cell fragments discernible at this magnification
Very few leukocytes and platelets visible
Resolution does not allow assessment of fine red cell morphology or inclusions
3059.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a well-spread monolayer of red cells of relatively uniform size and shape, with sparse leukocytes and platelets. No sickle cells, target cells or schistocytes are recognizable at this magnification, although fine morphologic detail cannot be assessed. The paucity of sickled forms is in keeping with compound heterozygosity for hemoglobin S and hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin, in which pancellular HbF inhibits polymerization; the diagnosis requires hemoglobin HPLC/electrophoresis and HbF distribution studies rather than morphology.

ddx.vs: HbSS smears show irreversibly sickled cells, target cells, polychromasia and Howell-Jolly bodies, which are not seen here.
S-beta thalassemia shows microcytosis, hypochromia and target cells with HbA2 elevation, whereas S/HPFH is normocytic with high pancellular HbF.
Both have a near-normal smear; HPLC shows HbA present in AS but absent with high HbF in S/HPFH.

22195.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆分葉核嗜中性球的細胞質邊緣（箭頭）有一小團深紫色顆粒狀包涵體（morula），背景血小板稀少，配合蜱蟲叮咬與血小板低下，符合無形體症（anaplasmosis）。
features: Segmented neutrophil with a small dense basophilic granular intracytoplasmic inclusion at the cell periphery (arrow)
Inclusion is distinct from the nuclear lobes and has a stippled morula-like texture
Neutrophil cytoplasm with fine pink granules
Normocytic, normochromic red cells with rare crenated forms
Very few platelets in the field, in keeping with thrombocytopenia
22195.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic erythrocytes and a paucity of platelets. A segmented neutrophil contains a small, dark basophilic, stippled intracytoplasmic inclusion separate from the nuclear lobes, consistent with a morula. No intraerythrocytic parasites are seen. In a patient with a recent tick bite, fever and thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with human granulocytic anaplasmosis; PCR confirmation and co-infection testing (Babesia, Borrelia, Powassan virus given neurologic symptoms) are recommended.

ddx.vs: Ehrlichia chaffeensis morulae are located in monocytes rather than neutrophils.
Döhle bodies are pale blue-grey, amorphous and homogeneous rather than dark and stippled.
Babesia parasites are intraerythrocytic rings and tetrads, not neutrophil inclusions.

ddx.dx: Detached nuclear fragment or overlying platelet
ddx.vs: A platelet or nuclear fragment has a different texture or focal plane and lacks the granular mulberry appearance.

19635.recognize_zh: 腎臟 H&E（A）可見近端腎小管上皮細胞內塞滿嗜伊紅性、呈碎裂或結晶狀的物質，電子顯微鏡（B）可見細胞內大量高電子密度的菱形/多角形結晶（inset），代表單株輕鏈在腎小管內形成結晶；這比較像輕鏈近端腎小管病變合併結晶，而非典型非結晶性的輕鏈沉積症。
features: Renal cortex with proximal tubules whose epithelial cells are distended by bright eosinophilic, fractured-appearing cytoplasmic material (panel A)
Tubular lumina partly effaced; some cells show vacuolization and sloughing
Interstitium with mild edema and scattered inflammatory cells; no glomerulus in the field
Electron microscopy showing numerous electron-dense geometric rhomboid and polygonal crystals packed within cell cytoplasm around nuclei (panel B and inset)
Linear granular basement membrane deposits typical of LCDD are not demonstrated in these panels
19635.describe_en: Kidney biopsy stained with H&E shows proximal tubules with epithelial cells distended by abundant bright eosinophilic, fractured-appearing cytoplasmic material, with focal vacuolization and cell sloughing and mild interstitial edema. Electron microscopy demonstrates numerous electron-dense rhomboid and polygonal crystalline inclusions filling the cytoplasm of the tubular epithelial cells. The powdery, non-crystalline linear deposits along tubular and glomerular basement membranes that define light chain deposition disease are not shown in these panels, so the image is only partially concordant with the title. Findings are consistent with a monoclonal light chain-related tubulopathy with intracellular crystals (light chain proximal tubulopathy/crystal-storing pattern) in the setting of an IgG monoclonal gammopathy; immunofluorescence for kappa and lambda is required to confirm light chain restriction.

ddx.vs: LCDD shows non-crystalline, finely granular electron-dense deposits along tubular and glomerular basement membranes with nodular glomerulosclerosis, rather than intracellular geometric crystals.
Cast nephropathy shows fractured, hard eosinophilic casts within distal tubular lumina with surrounding giant cell reaction, rather than crystals inside proximal tubular epithelial cells.
In crystal-storing histiocytosis the crystals accumulate in interstitial CD68-positive histiocytes rather than in tubular epithelial cells.
Osmotic nephrosis (e.g., IVIG, contrast) produces isometric clear cytoplasmic vacuoles without eosinophilic crystals or light chain restriction.

13491.recognize_zh: 肉眼可見抹片表面有藍紫色沉積物（B 在推片尾端成團），低倍下紅血球間散布許多深紫色無結構團塊，高倍為無細胞構造、蠟樣淡紫色的細胞外沉澱物及小球狀顆粒（箭頭），即冷凝球蛋白沉積（cryoglobulin deposits）。
features: Grossly visible blue-violet precipitate on the smear, with a dense clump at the edge in panel B
Low power: multiple extracellular aggregates of dark purple amorphous material entrapping red cells
High power: homogeneous, acellular, lilac to violet glassy deposits without nuclei or granules
Small round extracellular globules resembling platelets or cell fragments (arrow)
Rouleaux-like red cell clustering in background; an intact neutrophil for size comparison
13491.describe_en: Gross inspection of the blood smears shows a blue-violet precipitate, forming a discrete clump in one slide. At low power there are numerous extracellular aggregates of dark purple amorphous material entrapping red cells. At higher power the deposits are acellular, homogeneous, and glassy lilac-violet, without nuclear structure or granules, and small spherical globules are also seen free among red cells, where they may be counted as platelets or leukocytes by automated analyzers. Findings are consistent with cryoglobulin precipitates on a cooled blood smear, which in this clinical setting of bone pain should prompt evaluation for plasma cell myeloma with a type I cryoglobulin.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps show granular individual platelets with visible outlines, whereas cryoglobulin is structureless homogeneous material that dissolves when the sample is warmed to 37 C.
Stain precipitate is refractile dark granular debris lying on top of the smear in all planes and does not entrap red cells or disappear with warming.
Rouleaux are stacked red cells with blue background staining but lack discrete extracellular amorphous deposits.

ddx.dx: Clusters of tumor or plasma cells
ddx.vs: Tumor cell clusters have nuclei and cytoplasmic boundaries, which the acellular cryoglobulin deposits lack.

12531.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被大量芽細胞佔據（高核質比、細緻染色質、部分細胞質有空泡），箭頭指的是一顆成熟且形態異常的顆粒球，細胞質內有 Auer 小體，而芽細胞本身沒有；搭配流式同時表現 T 與骨髓系標記，符合混合表型急性白血病（MPAL）。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and variably prominent nucleoli
Blast cytoplasm is scant to moderate, basophilic, with some vacuoles and cytoplasmic blebs
Nuclei are round to irregular with occasional folding
A mature, dysplastic-appearing granulocyte (arrow) with clumped chromatin containing cytoplasmic inclusions reported as Auer rods (rod detail limited at this resolution)
Mitotic figure present; scant residual normal hematopoiesis
12531.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is replaced by a population of medium-to-large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, variably prominent nucleoli, irregular or folded nuclei, and scant basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. A mitotic figure is present. A mature, dysplastic-appearing granulocyte (arrow) contains cytoplasmic Auer rods, whereas Auer rods are not seen within the blasts; the rods themselves are difficult to resolve at this image resolution. Morphology alone cannot assign lineage; with flow cytometry showing TdT/CD34-positive blasts co-expressing cytoplasmic CD3 and myeloid markers, findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, T/myeloid.

ddx.vs: AML with maturation shows MPO-positive myeloblasts often containing Auer rods themselves and lacks cytoplasmic CD3 expression.

ddx.dx: T-lymphoblastic leukemia with aberrant myeloid antigens
ddx.vs: T-ALL may express CD13/CD33 but does not show MPO positivity or Auer rods, which would indicate true myeloid lineage.
ETP-ALL is CD1a-/CD8-, CD5 dim, with stem/myeloid markers but is MPO negative and lacks Auer rods.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related or MDS-related AML with dysplastic granulocytes
ddx.vs: Dysplastic maturing granulocytes with Auer rods also occur in myelodysplasia-related AML, which is separated by lineage-defining flow and cytogenetics.

3379.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的淋巴球核深染、核膜有多處摺痕與溝紋而呈腦迴狀（cerebriform），細胞質極少、無顆粒，與旁邊核分葉的嗜中性球及圓核小淋巴球不同，即為 Sézary 細胞。
features: Arrowed lymphoid cell slightly larger than a small lymphocyte with a high N:C ratio
Nucleus with folded, grooved, convoluted (cerebriform) outline and dense hyperchromatic chromatin
No visible nucleolus; scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Additional atypical hyperchromatic lymphoid cells nearby with irregular nuclear contours
Background of mature neutrophils, small lymphocytes and numerous platelets; red cells unremarkable
3379.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical lymphoid cell (arrow), slightly larger than a small lymphocyte, with a high N:C ratio and a dense, hyperchromatic nucleus with deeply folded, grooved, cerebriform contours and scant agranular cytoplasm. Other hyperchromatic lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear outlines are present among mature neutrophils and platelets. Findings are consistent with circulating Sézary cells; quantification (absolute Sézary count at least 1000/uL or CD4:CD8 at least 10, or loss of CD7/CD26) and T-cell clonality support Sézary syndrome in the appropriate clinical setting of erythroderma.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphocytes with nuclear clefts (e.g. benign erythroderma, drug reaction)
ddx.vs: Small numbers of cerebriform cells can occur in reactive states, so flow cytometry showing CD4+ T cells with loss of CD7/CD26 and a clonal TCR rearrangement is needed.
ATLL cells are multilobated with a flower-like (clover-leaf) nucleus and are HTLV-1 positive with CD25 expression.
T-PLL cells have a visible nucleolus, basophilic cytoplasmic blebs and a markedly high lymphocyte count with TCL1A rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma or CLL with cleaved nuclei
ddx.vs: These are B-cell neoplasms (CD19/CD20+, cyclin D1+ in MCL) rather than CD3/CD4-positive T cells.

3315.recognize_zh: 箭頭標示多個核呈腎形或馬蹄形、旁邊有嗜酸性核旁區的 hallmark cells，大箭頭指向核呈環狀（doughnut cell），加上核分裂與夾雜嗜酸性球，是 ALCL 的經典形態。
features: Sheets of large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and vesicular chromatin
Hallmark cells (small arrows) with eccentric reniform or horseshoe-shaped nuclei and an eosinophilic paranuclear Golgi region
Doughnut cell (large arrow) with a ring-shaped nucleus surrounding a cytoplasmic pseudoinclusion
Distinct nucleoli and several mitotic figures
Interspersed eosinophils and residual myeloid cells; loose edematous stroma at upper right
3315.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows sheets of large neoplastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli, with several mitotic figures. Numerous hallmark cells with eccentric horseshoe- or kidney-shaped nuclei and eosinophilic paranuclear regions are identified (small arrows), along with a doughnut cell with a ring-shaped nucleus (large arrow). Scattered eosinophils and residual myeloid precursors are intermixed. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pending confirmation with CD30 and ALK immunostains.

ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells have large eosinophilic nucleoli, are scattered rather than sheeted, and are CD15+/PAX5 weak and ALK negative.
Carcinoma lacks hallmark cells and is cytokeratin positive with negative CD30 and ALK.
DLBCL expresses CD20/PAX5 and lacks uniform CD30 and ALK.
PTCL-NOS lacks the uniform strong CD30 expression and characteristic hallmark cells, and is ALK negative.

3187.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全被一致性的中至大型單核細胞取代，核圓、染色質細緻並有小核仁，細胞質中等量淡藍色，殘存的正常造血細胞極少，並可見核分裂；形態不能判定系別，需流式證實 CD56+、sCD3− 的 NK 細胞。
features: Marrow aspirate replaced by a monotonous sheet of intermediate to large mononuclear cells
Round to slightly oval nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin and small but visible nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm without conspicuous azurophilic granules at this magnification
Occasional mitotic figure within the infiltrate
Few residual normal elements, including small lymphocytes, an eosinophilic myelocyte and scattered red cells
3187.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows near-complete replacement by a monotonous population of intermediate to large mononuclear cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm; granules are not conspicuous at this magnification. A mitotic figure is present, and residual hematopoietic elements are sparse. The morphology resembles blasts and does not establish lineage. With flow cytometry showing surface CD3-negative, CD56-positive NK cells and EBV positivity, the findings are consistent with aggressive NK-cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: AML blasts express CD34/CD117, MPO or monocytic markers (CD14, CD64) and lack cytoplasmic CD3E and EBER.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and are TdT and CD34 positive, whereas NK leukemia cells are TdT negative mature NK cells.
BPDCN is CD4+/CD123+/TCF4+ and EBV negative, although it also expresses CD56.
Plasma cells show eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138+/CD38 bright with light chain restriction.

1203.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學（紅色呈色）中大多數大型腫瘤細胞呈強烈、瀰漫的核染色，小淋巴球等背景細胞為陰性（藍色），配合原發性積液淋巴瘤（PEL），此核陽性型態符合 HHV8（LANA）或漿細胞相關核標記的表現。
features: Strong diffuse nuclear staining with red chromogen in the majority of large tumor cells
Positive nuclei round to oval and variably sized, reflecting large-cell morphology
Interspersed negative hematoxylin-counterstained smaller cells
Loose, discohesive cellular arrangement without tissue architecture
Marker not labeled; nuclear pattern compatible with HHV8 LANA or MUM1/IRF4
1203.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain with a red chromogen (marker not specified) shows strong, diffuse nuclear positivity in the majority of large, discohesive tumor cells, while interspersed smaller background cells are negative. The staining is confined to the nucleus without membranous or cytoplasmic reactivity. In the context of primary effusion lymphoma, this nuclear pattern is compatible with HHV8 latency-associated nuclear antigen (LANA) or MUM1/IRF4 expression, although LANA often appears more finely speckled. Findings support the diagnosis of primary effusion lymphoma; the identity of the antibody should be confirmed.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma is MUM1-positive but HHV8 LANA-negative and usually EBER-positive.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: HHV8+ DLBCL arises in lymph nodes/spleen, often with multicentric Castleman disease, and is typically EBV-negative, unlike the effusion-based EBV-coinfected PEL.
Extracavitary PEL shares the same phenotype but forms a solid tissue mass without a body cavity effusion.
Burkitt lymphoma shows nuclear MYC/Ki-67 near 100% with CD10/BCL6 and is HHV8-negative.

1203.stain: IHC: nuclear marker not stated (red chromogen)

1779.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中大腿皮膚有大片邊界清楚、呈地圖狀的深褐色壞死結痂，表面網格狀剝落並有暗紅出血點，周邊皮膚正常；在水痘感染後出現這種對稱的肢體出血壞死，應考慮後天性 protein S 缺乏引起的暴發性紫斑（purpura fulminans）。
features: Large, sharply demarcated, geographic area of cutaneous necrosis on the thigh
Dark brown, dry eschar with a reticulated (net-like) desquamating surface
Scattered dark red hemorrhagic foci within the necrotic plaque
Raised, peeling rim at the interface with normal-appearing skin
No vesicles or bullae visible at this stage
1779.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the thigh shows a large, sharply demarcated, geographic plaque of dry, dark brown necrotic eschar with a reticulated desquamating surface and scattered hemorrhagic foci, bordered by a peeling rim and normal-appearing adjacent skin. The lesion represents an evolved stage of hemorrhagic skin necrosis. In the context of recent varicella infection, the appearance is consistent with post-varicella purpura fulminans, typically due to autoantibody-mediated acquired protein S deficiency with dermal microvascular thrombosis.

ddx.vs: Occurs with overwhelming sepsis, shock and DIC in the acute illness rather than 1–2 weeks after a varicella rash with isolated low protein S.
Arises within days of starting warfarin in fatty areas (breast, thigh, buttock) in protein C–deficient patients.
Follows heparin exposure with falling platelet count and positive anti-PF4 antibodies.
Painful, rapidly spreading infection with crepitus and systemic toxicity, without the coagulation factor deficiency.

1651.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒邊緣有一顆細胞質淡染、邊界模糊的巨噬細胞，細胞質內散布許多深藍黑色、大小不一的吞噬碎屑顆粒（藍色箭頭），這些被吞入的碎屑讓你認出它是吞噬碎屑的巨噬細胞（debris-laden macrophage）。
features: Macrophage with abundant pale, poorly demarcated cytoplasm at the edge of a marrow particle
Numerous coarse dark blue-black and blue-green cytoplasmic granules of variable size representing ingested debris (arrow)
Round nucleus with fine chromatin, partly overlapped by adjacent cells
Surrounding marrow cells with open chromatin, some with scattered similar dark granules
Background red cells with drying artifact (crenated, dense forms)
1651.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marrow particle containing a macrophage with abundant pale cytoplasm stuffed with coarse, dark blue-black and blue-green granular debris (arrow). The adjacent marrow cells have open chromatin, and scattered red cells show drying artifact. No intact phagocytosed hematopoietic cells or microorganisms are identified at this resolution. Findings are consistent with a debris-laden (tingible body-type) macrophage, which indicates increased cell turnover or apoptosis; iron stain would distinguish hemosiderin from nuclear debris.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin granules are golden-brown to blue-green and refractile and are confirmed by Prussian blue positivity, whereas apoptotic nuclear debris is Prussian blue negative.
Mast cells have uniform, densely packed metachromatic granules filling a well-defined round or spindle cell, not irregular debris in a pale ill-defined macrophage.
Hemophagocytosis shows intact engulfed erythrocytes, platelets, or nucleated cells rather than fine granular debris.

1331.recognize_zh: 切片中大片均質、無細胞、淡粉紅色蠟樣的無定形物質沉積，包圍脂肪空泡並取代正常組織，只剩少數散在的造血細胞，這種淡嗜酸性無結構沉積物是類澱粉（amyloid）的典型 H&E 外觀，需以 Congo red 確認。
features: Extensive amorphous, homogeneous, pale eosinophilic acellular material with a waxy, glassy appearance
Deposits encircle and compress fat spaces and appear to involve vessel walls
Marked reduction of residual cellular elements, with scattered hematopoietic cells and red cells in narrow interstitial spaces
Cracking artifact and fissuring within the deposited material
A dense pink fragment at bottom center, likely bone or a thickened vessel wall
1331.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows extensive replacement of the marrow space by amorphous, homogeneous, pale eosinophilic acellular material with a waxy appearance and cracking artifact. The deposits surround fat spaces and appear to involve vessel walls, with only scattered residual hematopoietic cells in narrow interstitial spaces. A plasma cell infiltrate cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of amyloid deposition; Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence under polarized light and amyloid typing (e.g. mass spectrometry) are required for confirmation, and a clonal plasma cell population should be sought with kappa/lambda studies.

ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation shows pale, finely fibrillar light-staining ground substance that is Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative, rather than dense waxy material.
Collagen fibrosis is fibrillar with spindled fibroblasts and is highlighted by trichrome, whereas amyloid is acellular, glassy, and Congo red positive.
Edema fluid is paler and wispy without the dense waxy consistency and vascular wall involvement of amyloid.
LCDD deposits are Congo red negative and non-fibrillar by electron microscopy despite a similar H&E appearance.

2931.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血液抹片中，大量血小板緊密圍繞兩顆嗜中性球（中間偏帶狀核），像花環一樣黏附於細胞膜外，旁邊還有一顆小淋巴球，是典型的血小板衛星現象。
features: Dozens of normal-sized granular platelets rimming the outer membrane of a band neutrophil
Adjacent segmented neutrophil also partly encircled by platelets
Platelets are external to the neutrophil cytoplasm, not phagocytosed
Small mature lymphocyte nearby without adherent platelets
Few free platelets in the surrounding field; red cells unremarkable
2931.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows numerous normal-sized, well-granulated platelets adherent to the external surface of a band neutrophil and an adjacent segmented neutrophil, forming a rosette. A nearby small lymphocyte shows no platelet adherence. Free platelets are sparse elsewhere, and red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet satellitism, which can cause spurious thrombocytopenia on automated counts.

ddx.vs: ITP shows true platelet paucity without platelets adhering around neutrophils.
Clumps are free aggregates of platelets not bound to leukocyte surfaces, often accompanying but separate from satellitism.

ddx.dx: Leukocyte with phagocytosed platelets or bacteria
ddx.vs: Phagocytosed material lies inside the cytoplasm within vacuoles, whereas satellites line the outer cell margin.

2611.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，箭頭指出數個邊界不清、顏色較淡粉紅的圓形或不規則結節，由上皮樣組織球構成，與周圍深色造血組織形成對比，且沒有壞死，符合類肉瘤病（sarcoidosis）的非壞死性肉芽腫。
features: Low-power core biopsy with several pale, eosinophilic nodular aggregates marked by arrows
Aggregates composed of epithelioid histiocytes that contrast with surrounding darker hematopoietic marrow
No central necrosis evident in the nodules
Background marrow shows normocellular trilineage hematopoiesis with fat
Trabecular bone without significant abnormality
2611.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows normocellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis interrupted by several pale, poorly circumscribed nodules (arrows) composed of epithelioid histiocytes. The nodules lack central necrosis. Trabecular bone is unremarkable. Higher-power evaluation and special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi are needed to exclude infection. Findings are consistent with non-necrotizing granulomas, compatible with sarcoidosis in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas may show necrosis and demonstrable organisms on AFB/GMS stains and culture, which must be excluded.
Lymphoid aggregates are composed of small dark lymphocytes rather than pale epithelioid histiocytes, and lymphoma shows atypical lymphoid cells by IHC.
Hodgkin involvement shows fibrosis with mixed inflammatory cells and CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells.
Mast cell aggregates are paratrabecular or perivascular with spindle cells and eosinophils and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.

4723.recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血液低倍視野中即可數到五顆有核紅血球（NRBC），並伴隨紅血球大小不一、多染性大紅血球及少數橢圓形或淚滴狀紅血球，顯示骨髓對溶血的強烈造血反應，符合 RhD 新生兒溶血症。
features: Increased circulating nucleated red cells (about five in this field) with dense round nuclei and polychromatophilic or orthochromatic cytoplasm
Anisocytosis with scattered large pale polychromatophilic red cells
Mild poikilocytosis with occasional elliptocytes and teardrop forms
Few spherocytes; most red cells retain central pallor
One segmented neutrophil and scattered platelets
4723.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased numbers of nucleated red blood cells, with approximately five normoblasts in this field, together with a segmented neutrophil. The red cells show anisocytosis with scattered large polychromatophilic cells and mild poikilocytosis including occasional elliptocytes and teardrop forms, while spherocytes are not prominent. Platelets appear adequate. Findings indicate marked erythropoietic response with circulating normoblasts and are consistent with hemolytic disease of the newborn, such as RhD alloimmunization, in the appropriate clinical setting with a positive direct antiglobulin test.

ddx.dx: ABO hemolytic disease of the newborn
ddx.vs: ABO HDN is usually milder with numerous microspherocytes and fewer NRBCs, whereas RhD HDN shows more marked erythroblastosis with few spherocytes.
Normal neonates may have a few NRBCs in the first day, but not with anemia, marked polychromasia and a positive DAT.
Hypoxia and congenital infection also increase NRBCs, but they are DAT negative and lack alloantibody evidence.
TAM shows circulating megakaryoblasts and blasts in a newborn with trisomy 21, rather than a predominantly erythroid response.

1075.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指漿細胞的細胞核上可見一至數顆淡藍色、邊界清楚的圓形小體（Dutcher bodies），細胞質嗜鹼性、核偏位，背景為成熟中的顆粒球。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
One to several pale blue, sharply outlined round inclusions overlying the nucleus (Dutcher bodies, arrows)
Nuclear chromatin coarse with the inclusions appearing as clear-blue globules
Background of maturing granulocytes, an eosinophil, and scattered erythroid precursors
1075.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several plasma cells (arrows) with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm. The nuclei contain one to several pale blue, round, well-circumscribed inclusions consistent with Dutcher bodies, which represent cytoplasmic immunoglobulin invaginated into or overlying the nucleus. The background includes maturing granulocytes, an eosinophil, and erythroid precursors. Dutcher bodies are associated with clonal plasmacytic proliferations, including plasma cell neoplasms and lymphoplasmacytic or marginal zone lymphomas.

ddx.vs: Russell bodies are cytoplasmic globules that fill the cytoplasm rather than sitting over the nucleus.
Nucleoli stain deeper blue-purple, are usually single and irregular, and lack the glassy pale-blue, sharply rounded appearance of Dutcher bodies.
Superimposed vacuoles are clear rather than pale blue and change focal plane relative to the nucleus; PAS positivity supports true Dutcher bodies.

4211.recognize_zh: 幾乎每個紅血球都有細小環狀體（ring form），不少紅血球含多個環狀體或貼邊的 appliqué 型，中央還有一個香蕉形配子體（crescent gametocyte），紅血球大小不變，為高寄生率的惡性瘧（Plasmodium falciparum）。
features: Very high parasitemia: a large proportion of RBCs contain delicate ring forms
Multiple rings within single RBCs and rings with double chromatin dots
Accolé/appliqué forms at the RBC margin
Crescent (banana-shaped) gametocyte with dark pigment in the center of the field
Infected RBCs are not enlarged and lack Schüffner stippling; no mature trophozoites or schizonts seen
Scattered platelets and a single neutrophil; occasional crenated RBCs
4211.describe_en: Peripheral blood thin smear shows an extremely high parasite burden, with numerous small delicate ring forms involving a large proportion of red cells. Many red cells harbor multiple rings, some with double chromatin dots, and appliqué forms are present at the cell margins. A crescent-shaped gametocyte is seen in the center of the field. Infected red cells are normal in size without Schüffner dots, and late trophozoites and schizonts are not identified. Findings are diagnostic of Plasmodium falciparum malaria with hyperparasitemia (severe malaria); parasitemia should be quantified urgently.

ddx.vs: Babesia forms pleomorphic rings and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms without pigment or gametocytes, whereas a crescent gametocyte here is specific for P. falciparum.
These enlarge infected RBCs, show Schüffner stippling and all stages in blood, with round rather than crescent gametocytes.
P. knowlesi rings mimic falciparum but mature band forms and schizonts appear in blood and gametocytes are round; P. malariae has band forms and low parasitemia.
Overlying platelets lack a ring of blue cytoplasm with a discrete red chromatin dot and are not seen in so many cells.

4147.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆淋巴球具有中等量淡藍透明的細胞質，其中散布數顆明顯的粗大紫紅色嗜苯胺藍顆粒（azurophilic granules），核略凹陷、染色質緻密，即大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Single lymphocyte larger than a small lymphocyte
Moderate to abundant pale, clear-blue cytoplasm
Distinct coarse azurophilic (red-purple) granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nucleus with condensed chromatin; no nucleolus
Background normal red cells and occasional platelets
4147.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with a round to slightly indented nucleus with condensed chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm containing several coarse azurophilic granules, consistent with a large granular lymphocyte. Red cells and platelets appear unremarkable in this field. A single LGL is a normal finding; a persistent LGL count above 2 x 10^9/L with clonal T-cell receptor rearrangement and a CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ phenotype would support T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have deeply basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells and usually lack discrete azurophilic granules.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGL is morphologically identical and separated by CD3-negative, CD16/CD56-positive phenotype without TCR clonality.
Promyelocytes have fine chromatin with nucleoli and heavy granules, and monocytes have folded nuclei with gray vacuolated cytoplasm.

3827.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆巨大組織球，細胞質充滿均一的小空泡、呈淡藍灰色泡沫狀（桑葚或肥皂泡樣），核小而卵圓，體積遠大於周圍造血細胞，是 Niemann-Pick 泡沫細胞的典型樣貌。
features: Very large histiocyte, many times the size of adjacent neutrophils and red cells
Low N:C ratio with a single small oval nucleus and fine chromatin
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm filled with uniform small clear vacuoles (foamy/mulberry appearance)
No fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' texture
Background normal hematopoietic cells: metamyelocyte/band, myelocyte, lymphocytes, erythroid precursors
3827.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large histiocyte with a single small oval nucleus and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm uniformly packed with small, clear, round vacuoles, giving a foamy or mulberry appearance. The cytoplasm lacks the fibrillary striations of Gaucher cells. Surrounding hematopoietic cells appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a lipid-laden foam cell (Niemann-Pick cell), compatible with Niemann-Pick disease in the appropriate clinical context; confirmation by acid sphingomyelinase activity or NPC1/NPC2 testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have striated, fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than uniform round vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granules on Romanowsky stain, although they can coexist with foam cells in Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.dx: Foamy macrophages in hyperlipidemia or TPN/lipid infusion
ddx.vs: Secondary lipid-laden macrophages are fewer, occur with a clinical lipid source, and enzyme studies are normal.
MAC-laden histiocytes show faint striated negative images of bacilli and are strongly AFB positive.

3571.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞很擠，許多顆粒球系細胞（骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核）細胞質呈淡灰藍色、幾乎沒有顆粒，部分核呈圓形或低分葉；這種普遍的顆粒減少提示顆粒球生成異常（dysgranulopoiesis）。但此區為厚片、細胞重疊，細節判讀有限。
features: Hypercellular, crowded particle edge with overlapping nucleated cells
Numerous granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands) with pale gray-blue, hypogranular cytoplasm
Some mature granulocytes with round or hyposegmented nuclei and clumped chromatin
Admixed larger immature cells with finer chromatin in the upper field
Thick central area with dense stroma-like smeared material and fat vacuoles limiting cytologic detail
3571.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular, crowded particle edge composed predominantly of granulocytic precursors. Many myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms have pale, hypogranular cytoplasm, and some mature forms show round to hyposegmented nuclei. Larger immature cells with finer chromatin are also present, although blasts cannot be reliably enumerated in this thick field. The overlapping cells and thick smear limit assessment of individual dysplastic features. Findings are suggestive of dysgranulopoiesis with hypogranularity; confirmation in thinner areas with a formal count is recommended.

ddx.vs: Poor spreading and underfixation can make granules look faint diffusely, whereas true hypogranularity persists in well-spread areas while other cells retain normal granules.
Reactive granulopoiesis shows normal or increased (toxic) granulation rather than hypogranular cytoplasm.
AML requires at least 20% blasts on a formal differential, which cannot be established from this crowded field.

3699.recognize_zh: H&E 切片中大量核碎片（karyorrhectic debris）與凋亡小體，周圍是細胞核呈新月形或扭曲狀的組織球（crescentic histiocytes）及淋巴樣細胞，背景淡粉紅纖維素樣，且看不到嗜中性球，是 Kikuchi 淋巴腺炎的典型特徵。
features: Abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris and apoptotic bodies
Histiocytes with crescentic, twisted or indented nuclei and pale foamy cytoplasm
Admixed plasmacytoid dendritic cells and immunoblast-like larger lymphoid cells
Pale eosinophilic fibrinoid background
Conspicuous absence of neutrophils and eosinophils
3699.describe_en: Section shows a paracortical-type area with extensive apoptotic and karyorrhectic nuclear debris. Numerous histiocytes with crescentic or twisted nuclei, plasmacytoid dendritic cells and scattered larger activated lymphoid cells are present in a pale fibrinoid background. Neutrophils and eosinophils are notably absent, and no sheets of monotonous atypical cells are seen. Findings are consistent with histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis (Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease); correlation with ANA/anti-dsDNA is recommended to exclude lupus lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar but often shows hematoxylin bodies, plasma cells and vascular DNA deposition (Azzopardi phenomenon), and requires serologic correlation.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell or large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Shows sheets of cytologically atypical lymphoid cells with aberrant or clonal T-cell phenotype, whereas Kikuchi has a mixed CD8+ T-cell, histiocyte (MPO+/CD68+) and pDC population.
Contains neutrophils and microabscesses or viral inclusions, whereas Kikuchi necrosis is characteristically devoid of neutrophils.

3507.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中紅血球大多單獨分散，但散在數個由 2 至 5 顆紅血球互相重疊形成的不規則小團塊，並非直線的錢串狀；此圖的凝集程度輕微，需與抹片製作造成的重疊區分。
features: Mostly dispersed normocytic red cells with scattered small irregular clumps of 2-5 overlapping RBCs
Clumps are irregular rather than linear coin stacks
A single small mature lymphocyte
Occasional platelets; no spherocytes or schistocytes clearly identified
Agglutination is subtle in this field
3507.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows predominantly dispersed normocytic red cells with scattered small, irregular aggregates of two to five overlapping erythrocytes, without linear rouleaux formation. A mature lymphocyte and scattered platelets are present. No definite spherocytes are identified in this field. The findings are suggestive of mild red cell agglutination; because the degree is subtle, correlation with warming of the sample, a direct antiglobulin test, and cold agglutinin titer is advised.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are linear stacks of red cells associated with increased fibrinogen or paraprotein, rather than irregular clusters.

ddx.dx: Random overlap in a thick area
ddx.vs: Artifactual overlap is limited to the thick part of the smear and involves regularly overlapping pairs, while true agglutinates persist at the feathered edge.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes and polychromasia with an IgG-positive DAT, rather than agglutinates.

3443.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片右側一顆中性球的細胞邊緣附著並疑似吞入數個血小板，旁邊還有散在血小板，左側則有一團聚集的血小板；中性球吞噬血小板可造成假性血小板低下，需與血小板衛星現象區分。
features: Segmented neutrophil with a few platelets at its cytoplasmic margin, some appearing internalized
Neutrophil granulation and nuclear segmentation otherwise normal
Separate small platelet clump on the left side of the field
Scattered single platelets near the neutrophil
Red cells normochromic and normocytic with central pallor
3443.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic, normocytic red cells. A segmented neutrophil on the right has several platelets at its cytoplasmic edge, with at least one appearing to lie within the cytoplasm, and scattered single platelets nearby. A separate small platelet clump is present on the left. At this resolution, true internalization cannot be distinguished with certainty from platelets overlying the neutrophil. The appearance is consistent with leukocyte phagocytosis of platelets (an EDTA-related in vitro phenomenon), which can contribute to spurious thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: In satellitism platelets form a rosette around the entire outer membrane of neutrophils without being engulfed, rather than lying within the cytoplasm.
Bacteria are uniform small dark cocci or rods within vacuoles, often with toxic granulation, whereas platelets are larger, pale purple with central granules.
Döhle bodies are pale blue cytoplasmic patches and toxic granules are fine dark granules, not discrete granular platelet fragments.

3251.recognize_zh: 巨噬細胞泡沫狀細胞質內有一個圓形透明空泡，裡面含兩個小而深染的點狀結構，周圍有清楚光暈（假莢膜樣），符合細胞內 Histoplasma 酵母菌；單一視野、菌體數量少，需特殊染色佐證。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale-blue, finely vacuolated (foamy) cytoplasm
Single round clear vacuole containing two small, dense, dot-like basophilic bodies consistent with intracellular yeast forms
Clear halo around the organisms (pseudocapsule artifact)
Large, irregular reniform macrophage nucleus with fine chromatin
Adjacent small mononuclear cell with bleb-like cytoplasmic protrusions (degenerating cell or preparation artifact)
3251.describe_en: Smear shows a large macrophage with abundant foamy cytoplasm containing a round clear vacuole with two small, dense, basophilic bodies surrounded by a clear halo, suggestive of intracellular yeast forms. A nearby small mononuclear cell shows bleb-like cytoplasmic protrusions of uncertain significance. Only a single organism-containing vacuole is present in this field, so the morphology is suggestive rather than diagnostic on its own. Findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum infection in the appropriate clinical context; confirmation by GMS/PAS stain, culture or antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes show a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a clear halo, whereas Histoplasma yeasts are haloed single dots without a kinetoplast.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated sausage-shaped forms that divide by a central transverse septum rather than by budding.
Candida glabrata is slightly larger without a pseudocapsular halo and is distinguished definitively by culture.
Apoptotic fragments and platelets are irregular, lack a uniform halo and do not stain as fungal walls on GMS or PAS.

2867.recognize_zh: 放大後的 Sézary 細胞：核中央有一道斜向深溝，兩側摺疊的核葉如腦迴，染色質粗而緻密，外圍只有一圈淡藍色細胞質；影像解析度偏低，細部較模糊。
features: Lymphoid cell with high N:C ratio and a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Deep oblique nuclear groove with overlapping folds (cerebriform nucleus)
Coarse, condensed chromatin; nucleoli not visible
Image is enlarged and pixelated, limiting fine chromatin assessment
2867.describe_en: Magnified view of a peripheral blood lymphoid cell shows a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and a narrow rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm. The nucleus has a deep oblique groove with overlapping folds producing a cerebriform appearance, and the chromatin is coarse and condensed without visible nucleoli. The image is enlarged and pixelated, limiting fine detail. Morphology is consistent with a Sézary cell.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells show multilobated flower-shaped nuclei rather than a single deep cerebriform groove, and are HTLV-1 associated.
Mantle cells may show nuclear clefts but are B cells expressing CD5, cyclin D1 and SOX11 by ancillary studies.
Buttock cells have a sharp notch in a small nucleus and express CD10/BCL2 B-cell markers, requiring flow cytometry to separate.

2803.recognize_zh: 數顆大型單核球系細胞核呈腎形或折疊、染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍，並有一顆有核紅血球與一顆破碎細胞；幼稚單核球的出現符合 CMML，但單張無法計算單核球比例。
features: Several large monocytic cells with folded, reniform or lobulated nuclei
Fine to slightly clumped chromatin; some cells approach promonocyte morphology
Moderate to abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules
An orthochromatic normoblast (nucleated red cell) at upper left
Smudged/disrupted cell at right; red cells with mild anisocytosis
2803.describe_en: The smear shows several monocytic cells with folded or lobulated nuclei, fine chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm, some of which have immature features suggestive of promonocytes. A nucleated red cell and a smudged cell are also present, and red cells show mild anisocytosis. Dysplastic features in other lineages and the monocyte percentage cannot be evaluated in this single field. Findings are compatible with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia in the context of persistent absolute and relative monocytosis.

ddx.vs: Acute leukemia requires >=20% blasts including promonocytes, so careful separation of promonocytes from mature abnormal monocytes is critical.
Reactive monocytes are mature, lack accompanying dysplasia and are not clonal.
CML shows a myelocyte bulge with basophilia and is BCR::ABL1-positive, while monocytes are not dominant.
JMML occurs in young children with RAS-pathway mutations and elevated hemoglobin F.

2739.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中一顆大型巨核細胞，核高度分葉、分散成多個圓形葉片，細胞質豐富，旁邊有大片血小板聚集；成熟且過度分葉的大型巨核細胞搭配血小板增多背景，符合本態性血小板增多症（ET）。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm
Markedly hyperlobulated nucleus with many separate rounded lobes
Mature nuclear chromatin without hyperchromatic cloud-like atypia
Large adjacent sheet of aggregated platelets, suggesting platelet production/thrombocytosis
Admixed neutrophils, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes in the background
2739.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant cytoplasm and a markedly hyperlobulated nucleus composed of multiple rounded lobes with mature chromatin. An adjacent large platelet aggregate is present, and the background contains maturing granulocytic and erythroid cells and lymphocytes. There are no dysplastic small hypolobated megakaryocytes in this field. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia, pending correlation with platelet count, bone marrow biopsy architecture and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation status.

ddx.vs: Prefibrotic PMF shows megakaryocytes with high N:C ratio and hyperchromatic, irregularly folded cloud-like nuclei in tight clusters, best assessed on biopsy.
CML megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated ('dwarf') with marked granulocytic hyperplasia and BCR::ABL1 positivity.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: This entity shows ring sideroblasts and dyserythropoiesis in addition to large megakaryocytes.

2483.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血液抹片中可見幾個小型、核深染的有核細胞（形態像有核紅血球或小淋巴球），紅血球大小不一且血小板稀少；單看這張圖並不具專一性，需搭配單核球增多等其他表現才能支持 JMML。
features: Small nucleated cells with dense, clumped chromatin and scant irregular cytoplasm, possibly nucleated red blood cells or lymphocytes
One larger cell at right with dark irregular nucleus and scant cytoplasm
Red cells with mild anisocytosis and occasional stomatocyte-like central pallor changes
Platelets sparse, only small fragments seen
No blasts or monocytes clearly present in this field
2483.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows red cells with mild anisocytosis and scattered small nucleated cells with dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm, most suggestive of nucleated red blood cells or small lymphocytes; cytoplasmic detail is insufficient to separate them with confidence. Platelets are sparse. No monocytes or blasts are present in this field. These findings are nonspecific but can be seen in juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, where circulating nucleated red cells and thrombocytopenia accompany monocytosis.

ddx.vs: Nucleated red cells in stressed infants occur without monocytosis, splenomegaly or RAS-pathway mutations.
Hemolysis shows polychromasia, spherocytes or schistocytes and reticulocytosis rather than an increase in monocytes and immature myeloid cells.
Leukoerythroblastosis shows teardrop cells with left-shifted neutrophils, and the marrow reveals the infiltrating process rather than a myelomonocytic proliferation.

2099.recognize_zh: 這是一張 G-banding 染色體核型圖（female, XX），紅色箭頭標出第 3（第三條拷貝）、7、11（兩處）、13 號染色體的異常，屬於多重結構與數目異常的複雜核型，符合 ATLL 常見的核型表現。
features: G-banded karyogram; non-morphologic
Two X chromosomes, consistent with a female karyotype
Apparently three copies of chromosome 3, one marked by an arrow (possible trisomy 3 or derivative)
Arrows on one chromosome 7 (distal end), one chromosome 11 (two bands in the long arm region) and one chromosome 13 (terminal end), indicating structural abnormalities
Band resolution is modest, so exact breakpoints cannot be assigned from this image
2099.describe_en: A G-banded karyogram from a female patient is shown. Arrows highlight an apparent extra copy of chromosome 3 and structural abnormalities involving chromosomes 7, 11 (two marked sites) and 13. Together these constitute a complex abnormal karyotype. Exact breakpoints cannot be reliably defined at this banding resolution. In the context of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, a complex karyotype with numerical and structural changes, including gains of chromosome 3, is a recognized pattern.

2035.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E：背景為小淋巴球、漿細胞樣細胞與中型不規則核細胞的混合浸潤，中央有一顆雙核、核仁明顯、細胞質淡染的大型細胞（Reed-Sternberg-like cell）；多形性背景中出現這類大細胞，是多形性 PTLD 常見的表現。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and intermediate cells with irregular nuclei
Central large binucleate cell with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli (Reed-Sternberg-like)
Scattered large cells with open chromatin and pale cytoplasm
Occasional small pyknotic/apoptotic nuclei
Loose fibrillary, vacuolated background stroma
2035.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and intermediate cells with irregular nuclei, set in a loose fibrillary background. A large binucleate cell with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli, resembling a Reed-Sternberg cell, is present centrally, along with scattered other large transformed cells. Findings are consistent with polymorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder; immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD30, CD15, CD45) and EBER in situ hybridization are needed to exclude classic Hodgkin lymphoma-type PTLD.

ddx.vs: True HRS cells are CD30+, CD15+, CD45- with weak PAX5 and loss of CD20, while Reed-Sternberg-like cells in polymorphic PTLD usually retain CD20 and CD45.
Monomorphic PTLD consists of sheets of large transformed B cells rather than scattered large cells within a mixed small-cell background.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with EBV-positive B immunoblasts
ddx.vs: PTCL shows atypical T cells with clear cytoplasm and aberrant T-cell phenotype, with the large EBV-positive B cells being bystanders.

1907.recognize_zh: 中高倍下為單一形態的小至中型淋巴細胞，核輪廓略不規則、染色質較深，缺乏大型中心母細胞與免疫母細胞，並夾雜淡染的上皮樣組織球與粉紅色透明化小血管，符合套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Monotonous small to medium lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclear contours
Moderately condensed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Absence of admixed centroblasts, immunoblasts or proliferation centers
Scattered pale epithelioid histiocytes and small hyalinized pink vessels
1907.describe_en: Section shows a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Large transformed cells and proliferation centers are not seen. Scattered epithelioid histiocytes with pale cytoplasm and small hyalinized vessels are present. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, pending cyclin D1/SOX11 immunohistochemistry or CCND1 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL cells are round with clumped 'soccer-ball' chromatin and are accompanied by proliferation centers with paraimmunoblasts; LEF1/CD23 positive and cyclin D1 negative.
FL contains cleaved centrocytes admixed with centroblasts and is CD10/BCL6 positive, CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.
MZL shows monocytoid cells with more abundant pale cytoplasm and plasmacytic differentiation, and is CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.

1843.recognize_zh: 緊密排列的芽細胞群，核圓至不規則、部分有切跡或凹陷，染色質細緻、細胞質極少且無顆粒，其間散在幾顆小而深染的成熟淋巴球可作大小比較，符合淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Densely packed intermediate-sized blasts with very high N:C ratio
Round to irregular, notched or convoluted nuclear contours
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Scattered small mature lymphocytes with dense chromatin and a few crushed/smudged cells
1843.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of intermediate-sized blasts with very high N:C ratios and scant agranular cytoplasm. Nuclei are round to irregular with frequent notches and convolutions, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Scattered small mature lymphocytes and occasional crushed cells are present, while normal hematopoietic elements are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia, pending immunophenotypic lineage assignment.

ddx.vs: Convoluted nuclei are sometimes associated with T-ALL but are not lineage-specific; cytoplasmic CD3 versus CD19/CD79a by flow is required.
Cells may have irregular nuclei but are TdT-negative, CD5 and cyclin D1 positive with surface light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Separated by MPO or myeloid antigen expression by flow cytometry.
Show homogeneous condensed chromatin and a normal maturational B-cell pattern, usually as a minor population.

1587.recognize_zh: 極低倍免疫染色下，整個淋巴結內散布大量大小不一、邊界清楚的圓形到融合狀陽性結節，濾泡間區不染色；結節數量多且遍布全切片（不限於皮質），呈現濾泡型淋巴瘤的結節型分布；抗體名稱未標示（可能為 CD10 或 BCL6 等生發中心標記）。
features: Very low-power view with numerous closely spaced, round to coalescent nodules throughout the section
Nodules show strong, uniform chromogen staining with sharp borders
Interfollicular and background areas are negative (hematoxylin counterstain)
Nodules are distributed throughout the node rather than confined to the cortex
Some nodules fuse into irregular, dumbbell-shaped aggregates
1587.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain at scanning magnification shows a lymph node replaced by numerous closely spaced, sharply circumscribed positive nodules distributed throughout the section, including areas that would normally be medullary. The interfollicular areas are negative. The antibody is not labeled; if this is a germinal-center marker such as CD10 or BCL6, the stain highlights the neoplastic follicles and confirms a predominantly follicular growth pattern. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, follicular pattern, in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles are mostly cortical with intervening normal paracortex and are BCL2-negative, with a high Ki-67 and polarized germinal centers.
NLPHL nodules are larger and composed of small B cells with scattered LP cells within CD21-positive meshworks, and the nodules are not CD10-positive.
Nodular mantle cell lymphoma is CD10/BCL6-negative and cyclin D1-positive, so a germinal-center marker would not highlight its nodules.

1587.stain: IHC: marker not labeled (possibly CD10 or BCL6)
